title: When chemical potential continuity fails: kinetic interface models for hydrogen isotope transport
abstract: Macroscopic hydrogen transport codes model material interfaces with local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE), imposing continuity of chemical potential as a per-species constraint. Three assumptions hide in that condition: fast interfacial equilibration, a single exchange pathway between the two sides, and a carrier species known in advance on each side. The literature scrutinises the first, but the other two are the more consequential failures, and neither survives at a metal/molten-salt interface. We replace the constraint with reversible reaction channels at the interface that obey mass action, with detailed balance fixing each ratio of rate constants from the thermodynamic data that already parameterise LTE, and we implement the framework in festim. LTE is recovered as the fast-kinetics limit of a single channel, in both its Sieverts/Sieverts and its Sieverts/Henry form, so the framework generalises LTE and does not compete with it. A Damköhler number delimits validity within a channel, a branching ratio between channels. In a representative nickel/FLiBe system, hydrogen partitions kinetically between molecular and fluoride carriers. The apparent interfacial law then drifts between Sieverts and Henry with loading and salt redox state, and an LTE condition underestimates the steady permeating flux. The measured pressure exponent is set by the branching ratio, not by any fixed property of the salt; a redox sweep at fixed temperature should continuously shift it between 0.5 and 1. With two isotopes, two metal-side species feed five salt-side carriers, and a per-species LTE condition is ill-posed.
summary:
宏观氢传输代码模拟材料与局部热力学平衡（LTE）的界面，将化学势的连续性作为每个物种的约束。该条件隐藏了三个假设：快速界面平衡、两侧之间的单一交换路径以及每侧预先已知的载体种类。文献仔细研究了第一个，但其他两个是更严重的失败，并且在金属/熔盐界面上都无法幸存。我们用服从质量作用的界面处的可逆反应通道替换约束，并通过详细平衡固定来自已参数化 LTE 的热力学数据的每个速率常数比率，并且我们在 festim 中实现了该框架。 LTE 以其 Sieverts/Sieverts 和 Sieverts/Henry 形式恢复为单通道的快速动力学极限，因此该框架概括了 LTE 并且不与之竞争。 Damköhler 数界定通道内的有效性，即通道之间的分支比。在典型的镍/FLiBe 系统中，氢在分子和氟化物载体之间动态分配。

然后，随着负载和盐氧化还原状态，表观界面定律在 Sieverts 和 Henry 之间漂移，并且 LTE 条件低估了稳定渗透通量。测量的压力指数由支化比设定，而不是由盐的任何固定性质设定；固定温度下的氧化还原扫描应在 0.5 和 1 之间连续移动。对于两种同位素，两种金属侧物质为 5 个盐侧载流子提供能量，并且每种物质的 LTE 条件是不适定的。

title: Exact pair density wave in topological moire flat bands and universal superfluid stiffness
abstract:
Pair-density waves (PDWs) are unconventional superconducting states beyond the BCS paradigm, but identifying them unambiguously in microscopic lattice models is generally challenging due to various competing orders. In particular, an exact realization of PDW in interacting models with topological bands remains elusive. Here we construct an interacting model on a twisted bilayer checkerboard lattice (TBCB) featuring topological flat bands, and rigorously show that an exact PDW ground state can be induced by quantum geometric nesting (QGN), owing to its momentum-space nonsymmorphic symmetry. We further prove that the superfluid stiffness of any nondegenerate QGN superconductor (including the PDW studied here and uniform superconductor) obeys the universal relation $D_s=2N_{m flat}
u(1-
u)m_{m pair}^{-1}$, where $N_{m flat}$, $
u$, and $m_{m pair}$ are the number of flat bands, flat band filling, and the two-particle effective mass, respectively. Our results reveal a rich interplay among PDW order, quantum geometry, and band topology.
summary:
对密度波 (PDW) 是超出 BCS 范式的非常规超导态，但由于存在各种相互竞争的阶次，在微观晶格模型中明确识别它们通常具有挑战性。特别是，PDW 在与拓扑带相互作用的模型中的精确实现仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们在具有拓扑平带的扭曲双层棋盘晶格（TBCB）上构建了一个相互作用模型，并严格证明了由于其动量空间非对称性，量子几何嵌套（QGN）可以诱导精确的PDW基态。我们进一步证明任何非简并QGN超导体（包括这里研究的PDW和均匀超导体）的超流体刚度都遵循通用关系$D_s=2N_{m flat}
u(1-
u)m_{mpair}^{-1}$，其中$N_{m flat}$、$
u$和$m_{mpair}$是平带数、平带填充和双粒子有效质量，分别。我们的结果揭示了 PDW 阶数、量子几何和能带拓扑之间丰富的相互作用。

title: Quantized Transport through a Supermoiré Chern Mosaic
abstract: Magic-angle helical trilayer graphene---three graphene layers sequentially twisted in the same direction by $\sim1.8^\circ$---relaxes into a mosaic of domains that, at zero field, carry opposite valley-resolved Chern numbers, with boundaries hosting a network of gapless conducting modes. Charge transport through this network depends sensitively on how the modes connect and scatter, making well-quantized transport unlikely. Contrary to this expectation, we observe a field-induced Chern gap with Chern number $C=-6$ emanating from charge neutrality; in this gap, the Hall resistance is quantized to within $2\%$ of the expected value, $-h/6e^2$, at 4.6 K. We explain this behavior using both Hofstadter and orbital Zeeman calculations, which show that a moderate magnetic field drives a valley-selective topological transition. Above the transition, the total Chern number of the occupied states in each spin-valley flavor becomes identical across neighboring domains, and the domain-wall modes can become gapped. Though the central valence-band Chern numbers still differ between the two domain types, the observed quantized transport attests to a global gap.
summary: 魔角螺旋三层石墨烯——三个石墨烯层按 $\sim1.8^\circ$ 在同一方向顺序扭曲——松弛成域的马赛克，在零场时，这些域携带相反的谷分辨陈数，其边界承载着无间隙导电模式的网络。通过该网络的电荷传输敏感地取决于模式的连接和分散方式，因此不太可能实现良好的量化传输。与此预期相反，我们观察到场引起的陈能隙，其陈数 $C=-6$ 源于电荷中性；在这个间隙中，霍尔电阻在 4.6 K 时被量化到预期值 $-h/6e^2$ 的 $2\%$ 以内。我们使用 Hofstadter 和轨道塞曼计算解释了这种行为，该计算表明中等磁场驱动谷选择性拓扑转变。在转变之上，每个自旋谷风格中占据状态的总陈数在相邻域中变得相同，并且域壁模式可能变得有间隙。尽管两种域类型之间的中心价带陈数仍然不同，但观察到的量化输运证明了整体差距。

title: Hidden Frustration in Collinear Altermagnets: Pairing Vortices and Equilibrium Spin Current Loops
abstract: We show that a magnet can remain perfectly collinear while its quantum vacuum circulates. In a centrosymmetric altermagnet, a symmetry-allowed locally staggered Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya coupling imprints a gauge-irremovable vortex-antivortex pair into the anomalous magnon pair correlations at high-symmetry points in momentum space. In real space, these hidden vortices produce an antiferrochiral array of equilibrium spin currents circulating oppositely around neighboring plaquettes. Gauge-irremovable frustration therefore survives despite classical collinearity: it exists entirely in the quantum correlations. Our results show that complex pairing, gauge-invariant fluxes, and equilibrium loop currents - structures encountered across electronic flux phases, spin liquids, and frustrated quantum magnets - can be encoded in the squeezed vacuum of a collinear magnet.
summary: 我们证明，磁体在其量子真空循环时可以保持完美共线。在中心对称交替磁体中，允许对称性的局部交错 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 耦合将规范不可移除的涡旋-反涡旋对印入动量空间中高对称点处的反常磁振子对相关性中。在真实空间中，这些隐藏的漩涡产生平衡自旋电流的反铁手​​性阵列，在相邻的小板周围反向循环。因此，尽管存在经典共线性，但规范不可消除的挫败感仍然存在：它完全存在于量子相关性中。我们的结果表明，复杂的配对、规范不变通量和平衡环路电流（在电子通量相、自旋液体和受挫量子磁体中遇到的结构）可以在共线磁体的压缩真空中进行编码。

title: Statistics as a local phase: crystalline order and quench dynamics of emergent dimers in Ising gauge theories
abstract: How does the Bose or Fermi statistics of microscopic particles survive when confinement binds them into emergent bosonic composites? We address this question in the strong-coupling limit of a $2+1$D $\mathbb{Z}_2$ lattice gauge theory, where charges are confined into tightly bound pairs that can be described by an effective dimer model. We find that the statistics of the underlying matter is encoded entirely in a single local hopping phase $\varphi$ -$0$ for bosons, $\pi$ for fermions- while interactions remain statistics-independent. Treating $\varphi$ as a continuous parameter that interpolates between the two, we map the ground-state phase diagram with the help of tensor-network methods. The angle $\varphi$ itself drives a transition between a dimer-superfluid and dimer charge density wave state, while the magnetic coupling binds neighboring dimers into resonating pairs, in competition with the inter-dimer repulsion. We identify a novel gapped phase in which dimer pairs crystallize into an ordered pattern of resonating plaquettes. Finally, we propose a quench protocol under which identical dimer configurations evolve in markedly different ways depending on the statistics of their constituents. This provides a dynamical probe of the internal structure of dimers, and detects ordered phases through real time signatures, within reach of simulators that natively realize bosonic degrees of freedom.
summary:
当限制将微观粒子结合成新兴的玻色子复合材料时，玻色或费米统计如何保存？我们在 $2+1$D $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 晶格规范理论的强耦合极限中解决了这个问题，其中电荷被限制在可以通过有效二聚体模型描述的紧密束缚对中。我们发现底层物质的统计数据完全编码在单个局部跳跃阶段 $\varphi$ - $0$（玻色子），$\pi$（费米子）- 而相互作用仍然与统计无关。将 $\varphi$ 视为在两者之间插值的连续参数，我们借助张量网络方法绘制基态相图。角度 $\varphi$ 本身驱动二聚体超流体和二聚体电荷密度波状态之间的转变，而磁耦合将相邻二聚体结合成共振对，与二聚体间的排斥力竞争。我们发现了一种新的间隙相，其中二聚体对结晶成共振斑块的有序图案。

最后，我们提出了一种猝灭方案，在该方案下，相同的二聚体配置根据其成分的统计数据以明显不同的方式进化。这提供了二聚体内部结构的动态探针，并通过实时特征检测有序相，在本机实现玻色子自由度的模拟器的范围内。

title: Supercurrent detection and manipulation of topological phase transitions in Shiba-Majorana hybrid systems
abstract: The non-Abelian statistics of Majorana zero modes has inspired numerous proposals for their detection and manipulation in topological superconductors. Implementations based on magnetic adatoms deposited on superconductors draw particular attention due to their capabilities for precise atomic manipulation and the control over disorder. Here, we propose a scheme for detecting changes in the ground state parity of a topologically non-trivial adatom system by passing supercurrent through their low-energy modes. We unravel characteristic discontinuities in the critical current driven by zero-energy level crossings. We apply these findings to a setup where the Majorana coupling is mediated by a single control magnetic adatom hosting a Yu-Shiba-Rusinov state, and test the robustness of our results against finite temperatures and different tunneling regimes. Our findings introduce a non-invasive approach for reading out and controlling the ground state parity of Majorana states in Shiba-Majorana hybrid systems.
summary: 马约拉纳零模的非阿贝尔统计激发了许多在拓扑超导体中检测和操纵它们的建议。基于沉积在超导体上的磁性吸附原子的实现因其精确原子操纵和无序控制的能力而受到特别关注。在这里，我们提出了一种通过让超电流通过低能模式来检测拓扑非平凡吸附原子系统基态宇称变化的方案。我们揭示了零能级交叉驱动的临界电流的特征不连续性。我们将这些发现应用于马约拉纳耦合由托管 Yu-Shiba-Rusinov 态的单个控制磁性吸附原子介导的设置，并测试我们的结果针对有限温度和不同隧道状态的稳健性。我们的研究结果介绍了一种非侵入性方法，用于读取和控制柴马-马约拉纳混合系统中马约拉纳态的基态宇称。

title: How quantum is quantum geometry?
abstract: The quantum geometric tensor - the Berry curvature together with the quantum metric - now underlies a long list of observables, from the anomalous Hall effect to the superfluid weight of a flat band. We ask which of these observables actually require quantum mechanics. To answer this question, we study a purely classical system: a point particle carrying a classical magnetic moment $\boldsymbol{\ell}$ that precesses in a momentum-dependent magnetic field $\mathbf{B}(\mathbf{p})$. Within Hamiltonian classical mechanics, the component of $\boldsymbol{\ell}$ along the field reproduces the Berry-curvature phenomena, while its precessing transverse component reproduces the quantum-metric phenomena. The particle acquires a position spread whose second moment is the metric, an orbital magnetic moment, and - most strikingly - an inertial mass generated by a position-dependent force, and with it a nonzero Drude weight in a system that is nominally dispersionless.
summary: 量子几何张量——贝里曲率和量子度量——现在成为一长串可观测值的基础，从反常霍尔效应到平带的超流体重量。我们问这些可观察量中哪些实际上需要量子力学。为了回答这个问题，我们研究一个纯粹的经典系统：一个带有经典磁矩 $\boldsymbol{\ell}$ 的点粒子，它在动量相关的磁场 $\mathbf{B}(\mathbf{p})$ 中进动。在哈密顿经典力学中，$\boldsymbol{\ell}$沿场的分量再现了贝里曲率现象，而其进动横向分量再现了量子度量现象。粒子获得一个位置分布，其二阶矩是度量，一个轨道磁矩，以及最引人注目的一个由位置相关力产生的惯性质量，以及名义上无色散系统中的非零德鲁德权重。

title: Critical Properties and Glass Transitions in Randomly Coupled Fields
abstract: We study an assembly of $N$ scalar fields coupled via a quenched random interaction, equivalent to a spin glass whose spins are promoted to $d$-dimensional fields. When $N$ is large, the random coupling matrix produces a family of Gaussian universality classes whose critical exponents are determined by the behavior of the eigenvalue density near the spectral edge. For a Wigner matrix, the correlation length diverges at criticality but the susceptibility remains finite, and one-loop replica analysis supports an upper critical dimension of unity. In an exactly solvable spherical variant, the heat capacity jumps at the transition in $d>1$, and correlations remain pinned to their critical form throughout the glass phase, giving generic scale invariance despite the absence of a Goldstone mode.
summary: 我们研究通过淬火随机相互作用耦合的 $N$ 标量场的集合，相当于自旋玻璃，其自旋被提升到 $d$ 维场。当$N$很大时，随机耦合矩阵产生一系列高斯普适性类，其临界指数由谱边缘附近的特征值密度的行为确定。对于维格纳矩阵，相关长度在临界点发散，但敏感性仍然有限，并且单循环复制分析支持统一的上限临界维度。在完全可解的球形变体中，热容在 $d>1$ 的转变处跳跃，并且相关性在整个玻璃相中保持固定在其临界形式上，尽管没有戈德斯通模式，但仍具有通用的尺度不变性。

title: Information-theoretic formulation of the Traveling Salesman Problem
abstract: The Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) asks for the shortest route to visit a set of cities exactly once. It combines a simple local rule - each city must be visited once - with a hard, global constraint- all cities must be traversed within a single cycle. We cast the problem within a probabilistic, information-theoretic framework. The coexistence of local and global constraints is precisely what makes the problem difficult to address in this framework: the local rule can be enforced through vertex-level constraints, whereas the global constraint cannot be captured by independent edge probabilities. We show that this obstacle can be overcome by defining a maximum-entropy probability distribution over graphs, in which edge costs and degree constraints generate an assignment-like ensemble, and a global term, describing the hard constraint, tilts this ensemble toward Hamiltonian cycles. To make the construction tractable, we derive a mean-field approximation in terms of edge occupancies and implement a differentiable cycle penalty that suppresses sub-tours. This leads to a self-consistent numerical procedure whose output is not only a candidate tour but also a probability matrix encoding competing edges and degenerate solutions. We test the method on synthetic ensembles and on TSPLIB instances. The algorithm converges to connected tours in polynomial time, matching the best-known solution in the majority of instances and remaining within a small relative gap otherwise. Beyond its competitive performance, the proposed framework offers a general approach for handling hard constraints while reducing hard combinatorial optimization problems to simpler ones.
summary:
旅行商问题 (TSP) 要求找到访问一组城市一次的最短路线。它结合了简单的本地规则（每个城市必须访问一次）和严格的全局约束（所有城市必须在一个周期内遍历）。我们将问题置于概率、信息论框架内。局部约束和全局约束的共存正是使问题在该框架中难以解决的原因：局部规则可以通过顶点级约束来强制执行，而全局约束无法通过独立的边概率来捕获。我们证明，可以通过定义图上的最大熵概率分布来克服这个障碍，其中边缘成本和度约束生成类似分配的集合，并且描述硬约束的全局术语使该集合向哈密顿循环倾斜。为了使构造易于处理，我们根据边缘占用推导出平均场近似，并实现抑制子旅行的可微循环惩罚。

这导致了一个自洽的数值过程，其输出不仅是候选路径，而且是编码竞争边和简并解的概率矩阵。我们在合成集成和 TSPLIB 实例上测试该方法。该算法在多项式时间内收敛到连接的旅行，在大多数情况下匹配最著名的解决方案，并在其他情况下保持在较小的相对差距内。除了其具有竞争力的性能之外，所提出的框架还提供了一种处理硬约束的通用方法，同时将硬组合优化问题简化为更简单的问题。

title: Dynamical signatures of deconfined spinons in dimerized sawtooth chains
abstract: We study the ground-state properties and dynamical response of the Heisenberg model on the sawtooth chain in and away from the exactly solvable valence-bond-solid (VBS) point. We employ U(1)-symmetric density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) and time-dependent variational principle (TDVP) methods to compute equilibrium diagnostics and the zero-temperature dynamical structure factor (DSF) $S^{zz}(q,\omega)$ across the dimerized phase, a valence-bond-ordered state in which the two symmetry-equivalent apex--base bonds of each triangle develop unequal spin correlations, probing the approach to the continuous lower phase boundary, the exact VBS point, and the approach to the first-order upper boundary. In every regime, the DSF is a broad continuum dominated by a bright band at its lower edge, with the intensity at the one-triplon energy $\omega \simeq J_{AB}$ suppressed. We identify the spectrum as a deconfined two-spinon continuum of kink and antikink domain walls between the two degenerate singlet coverings. Closed-form spinon dispersions fix the continuum edges and track the dominant band across the zone in all three regimes, while an explicit finite-separation two-kink calculation in a constrained Hilbert space reproduces the measured intensity distribution. Our results provide a microscopic picture of fractionalized excitations in the dimerized sawtooth chain and are relevant to the recently discovered Ti$^{3+}$ kagome fluorides, where strongly anisotropic exchange interactions can generate sawtooth-chain building blocks.
summary:
我们研究了海森堡模型在锯齿链上位于和远离精确可解价键固体（VBS）点的基态特性和动力学响应。我们采用 U(1)-对称密度矩阵重正化群 (DMRG) 和时间相关变分原理 (TDVP) 方法来计算平衡诊断和二聚相的零温动态结构因子 (DSF) $S^{zz}(q,\omega)$，这是一种价键有序状态，其中每个三角形的两个对称等价的顶点 - 基键形成不等的自旋相关性，探索连续下相边界、精确的 VBS 点以及接近一阶上边界。在每种情况下，DSF 都是一个宽阔的连续体，其下边缘有一个亮带，其强度在一三重子能量 $\omega \simeq J_{AB}$ 处受到抑制。我们将光谱识别为两个简并单重态覆盖物之间的扭结和反扭结域壁的去限制的双自旋连续体。

闭合形式自旋色散固定连续体边缘并在所有三种状态下跟踪整个区域的主带，而受限希尔伯特空间中的显式有限分离二扭结计算再现了测量的强度分布。我们的结果提供了二聚锯齿链中分级激发的微观图片，并且与最近发现的 Ti$^{3+}$ kagome 氟化物相关，其中强各向异性交换相互作用可以生成锯齿链构建块。

title: Magnetic Communication with an Acoustically Actuated Magnetoelectric Resonator and a Quantum Diamond Magnetometer
abstract: Wireless communication via propagating magnetic fields is a communication modality that has recently garnered significant interest for short-to-medium range communication in conductive mediums, such as underwater and underground, where existing approaches utilizing electric fields are highly inefficient. Typical implementations of magnetic communication make use of loop antennas as both the transmitter and receiver, with the sensitivity and frequency response scaling with and inversely with the loop cross-sectional area, respectively. Here, we explore an alternative hybrid magnetic communication system consisting of an highly radiation efficient and compact acoustically actuated magnetoelectric resonator as the transmitter, and a highly sensitive micrometer scale quantum magnetometer based on nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond as the receiver, with their core properties unconstrained by size. We demonstrate amplitude and phase-encoded transmission and reception of AC magnetic fields at $f_{\mathrm{AC}}$ = 20 kHz, achieving a sensitivity of 50 pT/$\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ and 1.2 mrad/$\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$, respectively. This work establishes the use of hybrid magnetoelectric resonator and quantum diamond magnetometer communication system as a viable alternative to existing loop-based approaches.
summary:
通过传播磁场的无线通信是一种通信方式，最近引起了人们对导电介质（例如水下和地下）中短程到中程通信的极大兴趣，在这些介质中，现有的利用电场的方法效率非常低。磁通信的典型实现利用环形天线作为发射器和接收器，灵敏度和频率响应分别与环形横截面积成正比。在这里，我们探索了一种替代混合磁通信系统，该系统由作为发射器的高辐射效率和紧凑的声驱动磁电谐振器和作为接收器的基于金刚石氮空位中心的高灵敏度微米级量子磁力计组成，其核心特性不受尺寸限制。我们演示了在 $f_{\mathrm{AC}}$ = 20 kHz 时交流磁场的幅度和相位编码传输和接收，分别实现了 50 pT/$\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ 和 1.2 mrad/$\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ 的灵敏度。

这项工作建立了混合磁电谐振器和量子金刚石磁力计通信系统的使用，作为现有基于环路的方法的可行替代方案。

title: Fluctuation--response relations from an emergent $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry in the rotating stochastic Landau model
abstract: In this work, we investigate the extent to which fluctuation--response relations emerge from coarse-grained stochastic dynamics alone, and which aspects instead depend on additional information about the system. To address this question, we study the rotating stochastic Landau model, an exactly solvable system describing an overdamped charged Brownian particle in a constant magnetic field, coupled dissipatively to a rotating environment, whose steady state supports circulating probability currents. Using the Martin--Siggia--Rose path integral, we show that there is an emergent $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry transformation that implements the time-reversed dynamics and changes the action by a boundary term. Comparison with the Crooks fluctuation theorem identifies this term with the entropy associated with transitions between steady-state configurations. After coupling the theory to external sources, the same symmetry yields Ward identities relating fluctuations and response. These identities follow entirely from the coarse-grained stochastic theory and do not fix the noise strength. Finally, upon imposing the Einstein relation, we show that they coincide with the high-temperature fluctuation--dissipation relations implied by the rotating Kubo--Martin--Schwinger condition for a microscopic Gibbs ensemble.
summary:
在这项工作中，我们研究了波动响应关系在多大程度上仅从粗粒度随机动力学中产生，以及哪些方面依赖于有关系统的附加信息。为了解决这个问题，我们研究了旋转随机朗道模型，这是一个精确可解的系统，描述恒定磁场中的过阻尼带电布朗粒子，与旋转环境耗散耦合，其稳态支持循环概率电流。使用 Martin--Siggia--Rose 路径积分，我们表明存在一个新兴的 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 对称变换，它实现了时间反转动力学并通过边界项改变了作用。与克鲁克斯涨落定理的比较表明该术语与稳态配置之间的转变相关的熵。将理论与外部源耦合后，相同的对称性产生了与波动和响应相关的沃德恒等式。这些恒等式完全遵循粗粒度随机理论，并且不固定噪声强度。

最后，通过施加爱因斯坦关系，我们证明它们与微观吉布斯系综的旋转久保-马丁-施温格条件所隐含的高温涨落-耗散关系相一致。

title: Beyond Allen-Heine-Cardona: non-perturbative electron-phonon interactions in the linewidths and lineshifts of diamond
abstract: The temperature-dependent band gap of solids is usually computed from the perturbative Allen-Heine-Cardona (AHC) electron-phonon self-energy evaluated on-shell. Extending AHC to arbitrary frequency $\omega$ to determine the full spectral function via the Dyson equation is known to fail, misplacing satellites and yielding no broadening at band extrema, while non-perturbative supercell (SC) methods have focused on eigenvalue averages rather than lineshapes, and approaches based on special displacements cannot describe the full lineshape, or the lineshift at degenerate bands. Here we use a non-perturbative Green's function method (NPG), stochastically sampling distorted SC configurations, from which the spectral function, including lineshift, linewidth, and asymmetry, follows directly, and we recover finite spectral weight at the renormalized band extrema. We prove that the perturbative self-energy, computed to any order with the bare propagator and introduced into the Dyson equation, has an imaginary part that vanishes within the bare gap, giving incorrect spectral functions: self-consistency of the propagator is essential to broaden the band edges. NPG satisfies this property by construction, and contains all non-bubble diagrams. We also give a simple explanation of why SC methods converge with much smaller SCs than the corresponding $\mathbf{q}$-grids required by perturbation theory. For the band gap shift itself, the NPG and on-shell AHC results are found to be comparable, demonstrating that higher-order terms do not significantly alter the resulting renormalization in diamond. When it comes to the spectral function though, our results show that going beyond bare perturbation theory is not merely more accurate, but necessary, and NPG provides a robust framework to capture spectral broadening and higher-order effects from first principles.
summary:
固体的温度相关带隙通常是根据壳上评估的微扰 Allen-Heine-Cardona (AHC) 电子声子自能来计算的。众所周知，将 AHC 扩展到任意频率 $\omega$ 来通过戴森方程确定完整的谱函数会失败，卫星会错位，并且在频带极值处不会产生展宽，而非微扰超单元 (SC) 方法则侧重于特征值平均值而不是线形，并且基于特殊位移的方法无法描述完整的线形或简并频带处的线移。在这里，我们使用非微扰格林函数方法 (NPG)，对扭曲的 SC 配置进行随机采样，从中直接得出光谱函数，包括线移、线宽和不对称性，并且我们在重整化带极值处恢复有限的光谱权重。我们证明，用裸传播器计算任意阶并引入戴森方程的微扰自能，其虚部在裸间隙内消失，从而给出不正确的谱函数：传播器的自洽对于拓宽能带边缘至关重要。

NPG 通过构造满足此属性，并包含所有非气泡图。我们还简单解释了为什么 SC 方法收敛于比微扰理论所需的相应 $\mathbf{q}$ 网格小得多的 SC。对于带隙位移本身，NPG 和壳上 AHC 结果具有可比性，这表明高阶项不会显着改变金刚石中产生的重整化。不过，当谈到谱函数时，我们的结果表明，超越纯粹的微扰理论不仅更准确，而且是必要的，并且 NPG 提供了一个强大的框架来捕获谱展宽和来自第一原理的高阶效应。

title: Field-amplified readouts of weak altermagnetic exchange in MnF$_2$
abstract: MnF$_2$, the textbook two-sublattice antiferromagnet, has reemerged as a prototypical altermagnet, yet the sublattice-odd exchange that defines this identity remains under active debate: it enters the magnon splitting only in quadrature with the dipole--dipole interaction, its magnitude suppressed and its sign erased. An overdetermined first-principles total-energy mapping resolves this scale as a seventh-neighbor imbalance $\delta{J_7}\simeq+8~\mu$eV. The resulting Hamiltonian, with the dipole--dipole interaction included explicitly, reproduces the low-energy gap and the visible finite-momentum splitting. A longitudinal field $B\parallel c$ then acts as a linear amplifier of the hidden scale, opening two signed, field-linear readouts. The first is the compensation field $B^\ast(\mathbf Q)$, the position of minimum splitting, which is equal and opposite at the rotation-related partner momenta: a shift from zero field is itself evidence of a finite imbalance, its side gives the sign, and its magnitude, $|B^\ast|\simeq0.34$~T here, gives the scale. The second is the fixed-field contrast of the partner splittings, $\simeq0.14$~meV at $1$~T, six times the zero-field excess: a sign check from just two spectra. Both readouts survive a $0.12$~meV energy resolution, and the construction carries over to any easy-axis collinear altermagnet, bringing $\mu$eV altermagnetic exchange within present instrumental reach.
summary:
MnF$_2$，教科书上的二亚晶格反铁磁体，已经作为典型的交替磁体重新出现，但定义这种特性的亚晶格奇数交换仍然处于活跃的争论中：它仅以与偶极子-偶极子相互作用正交的方式进入磁振子分裂，其幅度被抑制，其符号被擦除。超定第一原理总能量映射将此尺度解析为第七邻域不平衡 $\delta{J_7}\simeq+8~\mu$eV。由此产生的哈密顿量，明确包含偶极子-偶极子相互作用，再现了低能隙和可见的有限动量分裂。然后，纵向场 $B\parallel c$ 充当隐藏标度的线性放大器，打开两个带符号的场线性读数。第一个是补偿场 $B^\ast(\mathbf Q)$，最小分裂的位置，在与旋转相关的伙伴动量处相等且相反：从零场的偏移本身就是有限不平衡的证据，其侧面给出符号，其大小 $|B^\ast|\simeq0.34$~T 给出尺度。

第二个是伙伴分裂的固定场对比度，$1$~T 处的 $\simeq0.14$~meV，是零场过剩的六倍：仅从两个光谱进行符号检查。两种读数均能维持 0.12$~meV 的能量分辨率，并且该结构适用于任何易轴共线交变磁体，使 $\mu$eV 交变磁体交换达到当前仪器的范围。

title: Dynamical phase selection controls compute scaling in looped transformers
abstract: A looped transformer performs inference by iterating a weight-tied map, making its computation a dynamical process whose cost is set by the resulting inference dynamics. Here we show that networks with identical architecture and objective, trained to identical accuracy, nevertheless realize distinct dynamical phases depending strongly on initialization, and that the bifurcation defining each phase determines how test-time compute scales. The phases are distinguished by their bifurcation mechanisms, including a saddle-node fold and a Neimark-Sacker-type transition to bounded nonstationary motion. In the fold phase, a one-dimensional normal-form reduction predicts both the relaxation-time and spectral-gap amplitudes from local derivatives of the trained map, yielding the parameter-free relation $\tau(\varepsilon)[1-\lambda_{\max}(-\varepsilon)]\to\pi$. Composed with a regular distribution of problem difficulty, the same critical slowing down produces the workload-level tail $P(\tau>N)\sim N^{-2}$. In the Neimark--Sacker phase, the fold scaling law disappears rather than merely changing its prefactor. Thus, test-time compute is not determined by architecture alone. It is governed by the dynamical phase of the solution found by training.
summary:
循环变压器通过迭代权重绑定映射来执行推理，使其计算成为一个动态过程，其成本由结果推理动态设置。在这里，我们展示了具有相同架构和目标的网络，经过相同精度的训练，仍然实现了强烈依赖于初始化的不同动态阶段，并且定义每个阶段的分叉决定了测试时计算的扩展方式。这些相的特点是分叉机制，包括鞍结折叠和内马克-萨克尔型有界非平稳运动的过渡。在折叠阶段，一维范式简化根据训练图的局部导数预测弛豫时间和谱间隙幅度，产生无参数关系 $\tau(\varepsilon)[1-\lambda_{\max}(-\varepsilon)]\to\pi$。与问题难度的规则分布相结合，同样的关键减速会产生工作负载级别尾 $P(\tau>N)\sim N^{-2}$。在内马克-萨克尔阶段，折叠缩放定律消失，而不仅仅是改变其前因子。因此，测试时计算不仅仅由架构决定。

它由训练找到的解决方案的动态阶段控制。

title: Atomic investigations on the mechanical properties of CoCrNi medium-entropy alloy nanowires
abstract: This work investigated the mechanical properties of CoCrNi medium-entropy alloy (MEA) nanowires under uniaxial tensile loading along three crystallographic orientations [100], [110] and [111].The CoCrNi single crystal nanowires with face-centered cubic (FCC) structure exhibits a strong anisotropic this http URL dynamics simulations were employed to give atomic-level insight into the plastic this http URL surface effect causes dislocations emitted from the free surface and slip into the internal. The temperature effect was also considered. Under identical geometric configurations, crystal orientations and temperature, interatomic interactions dominate key mechanical properties such as Young's modulus and yield this http URL results reveal a promounced linear correlation between the average atomic force and mechanical performance across eight representative FCC metallic nanowires (Al, Au, Ag, Cu, Ni, Al19Mg alloy, FeCoCrCuNi high-entropy alloy and CoCrNi MEA). This study delivers novel insights into the mechanical behavior of metallic nanowires, and offers guidance for the rational design of alloy nanowires.
summary: 这项工作研究了 CoCrNi 中熵合金 (MEA) 纳米线在沿三个晶体取向的单轴拉伸载荷下的机械性能 [100]、[110] 和 [111]。具有面心立方 (FCC) 结构的 CoCrNi 单晶纳米线表现出很强的各向异性。http URL 动力学模拟用于对塑料进行原子级洞察。http URL 表面效应导致位错从自由表面发射并滑入内部。还考虑了温度影响。在相同的几何构型、晶体取向和温度下，原子间相互作用主导着杨氏模量等关键机械性能，并得出此 http URL 结果揭示了八种代表性 FCC 金属纳米线（Al、Au、Ag、Cu、Ni、Al19Mg 合金、FeCoCrCuNi 高熵合金和 CoCrNi MEA）的平均原子力和机械性能之间存在显着的线性相关性。这项研究为金属纳米线的机械行为提供了新颖的见解，并为合金纳米线的合理设计提供了指导。

title: Thermally quenched metastability in metal-insulator transitions via elemental substitution
abstract: Thermal quenching inhibits equilibration toward the thermodynamic ground state during phase transitions, revealing metastable phases such as structural glasses and quenched alloys. Whether such thermally quenched metastability can be realized in metal-insulator transitions has remained an open question because these transformations are governed by collective electronic reorganization rather than atomic diffusion. We demonstrate that rapid cooling exceeding 10$^9$ K s$^{-1}$ kinetically avoids the metal-insulator transition, stabilizing a long-lived metastable metallic phase in tungsten-substituted VO$_2$. Temperature-dependent relaxation reveals nucleation-dominated kinetics with a thermal activation barrier introduced by tungsten substitution. Our results establish elemental substitution as a route to thermally quenched metastability in metal-insulator transitions, expanding metastable phase control to electronic phases.
summary: 热淬火抑制相变过程中向热力学基态的平衡，从而揭示结构玻璃和淬火合金等亚稳态相。这种热猝灭亚稳态是否可以在金属-绝缘体转变中实现仍然是一个悬而未决的问题，因为这些转变是由集体电子重组而不是原子扩散控制的。我们证明，超过 10$^9$ K s$^{-1}$ 的快速冷却在动力学上可以避免金属-绝缘体转变，从而稳定钨取代的 VO$_2$ 中的长寿命亚稳态金属相。温度依赖性弛豫揭示了成核主导的动力学以及由钨取代引入的热激活势垒。我们的结果确立了元素替代作为金属-绝缘体转变中热淬火亚稳态的途径，将亚稳态相控制扩展到电子相。

title: Emptiness formation in the Lieb-Liniger gas: hydrodynamic instantons and a conjectured rate function
abstract: We study the emptiness formation probability (EFP) in the ground state of the repulsive one-dimensional Lieb-Liniger Bose gas. For a macroscopic empty interval of length $2R$, its leading asymptotic behavior is described by a rate function $f(\gamma_0)$, defined by $-\log P(R)\sim(\rho_0R)^2f(\gamma_0)$, where $\rho_0$ is the mean density and $\gamma_0$ is the dimensionless interaction strength. We propose a parameter-free integral equation for $f(\gamma_0)$. Starting from the exact dual-field Fredholm-determinant representation of the EFP, we show how the conjectured kernel arises formally and identify the uniform asymptotic statement that remains to be proven for a rigorous derivation. The conjecture reproduces the Tonks-Girardeau and weak-coupling limits, as well as the first correction obtained independently in both limits. It also agrees at the few-percent level with numerical minimization of the Lieb-Liniger hydrodynamic action over more than four orders of magnitude in coupling. The numerical calculation yields the corresponding emptiness instantons and their astroid-like vacuum regions.
summary: 我们研究了排斥性一维 Lieb-Liniger Bose 气体基态下的空洞形成概率 (EFP)。对于长度为 $2R$ 的宏观空区间，其主要渐近行为由速率函数 $f(\gamma_0)$ 描述，该函数由 $-\log P(R)\sim(\rho_0R)^2f(\gamma_0)$ 定义，其中 $\rho_0$ 是平均密度，$\gamma_0$ 是无量纲相互作用强度。我们提出了 $f(\gamma_0)$ 的无参数积分方程。从 EFP 的精确双场 Fredholm 行列式表示开始，我们展示了猜想的内核如何正式出现，并确定了有待严格推导证明的一致渐近声明。该猜想再现了 Tonks-Girardeau 极限和弱耦合极限，以及在这两个极限中独立获得的第一个修正。它还在百分之几的水平上与耦合中超过四个数量级的 Lieb-Liniger 流体动力作用的数值最小化相一致。数值计算得出相应的空瞬子及其类星体真空区域。

title: Non-Hermitian Skin Effect from Radiative Coupling in a Reciprocal Chiral Medium
abstract: We find that long-range radiative coupling through a passive reciprocal chiral medium produces an unusual non-Hermitian skin effect in a chain of electric dipoles. Although the system is reciprocal, the chirality generates polarization-dependent phase accumulation and attenuation, leading to degenerate pairs of skin modes localized at opposite boundaries. We find that the skin mode profile consists of an exponential contribution from an isolated complex-$\beta$ pole and a longer-range tail proportional to $1/[n(\ln n)^2]$, where $n$ is the distance from the occupied boundary measured in lattice sites. Finite-chain calculations show that part of the OBC spectrum contracts toward the Bloch spectrum, whereas the number of boundary-localized modes remains extensive.
summary: 我们发现，通过无源互易手性介质的长程辐射耦合会在电偶极子链中产生不寻常的非厄米集肤效应。尽管该系统是互易的，但手性会产生偏振相关的相位积累和衰减，导致位于相反边界的简并趋肤模式对。我们发现趋肤模式轮廓由孤立的复数 $\beta$ 极点和与 $1/[n(\ln n)^2]$ 成比例的较长距离尾部的指数贡献组成，其中 $n$ 是在晶格位点中测量的距占用边界的距离。有限链计算表明，部分 OBC 谱向布洛赫谱收缩，而边界局域模式的数量仍然很广泛。

title: Instability of two-dimensional nonrelativistic altermagnets
abstract: Altermagnets (AMs) are collinear compensated magnets that exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without requiring a net magnetization. Since local magnetic moments and exchange-driven order do not rely on relativistic effects, altermagnetism can be naturally formulated in a nonrelativistic spin-group framework. This raises a basic question: can two-dimensional altermagnetic order be stabilized by purely exchange interactions in the absence of spin-orbit-induced anisotropy? We address this question by applying Bogoliubov's inequality to a minimal $d$-wave altermagnetic spin model. We show that the anisotropic exchange pattern responsible for altermagnetism still contributes only a quadratic long-wavelength term to the Bogoliubov denominator. Consequently, short-ranged exchange interactions alone cannot stabilize long-range altermagnetic order in two dimensions when continuous spin-rotation symmetry is preserved. In contrast, the corresponding three-dimensional system has a finite small-momentum contribution and is not ruled out by the Mermin-Wagner argument.
summary: 交替磁体 (AM) 是共线补偿磁体，无需净磁化即可表现出动量相关的自旋分裂。由于局部磁矩和交换驱动的秩序不依赖于相对论效应，因此可以在非相对论自旋群框架中自然地表述交变磁性。这就提出了一个基本问题：在没有自旋轨道引起的各向异性的情况下，二维交变磁序能否通过纯粹的交换相互作用来稳定？我们通过将 Bogoliubov 不等式应用于最小 $d$ 波交磁自旋模型来解决这个问题。我们表明，导致交变磁性的各向异性交换模式仍然只对博戈柳博夫分母贡献二次长波长项。因此，当保持连续自旋旋转对称性时，仅靠短程交换相互作用无法稳定二维中的长程交变磁序。相比之下，相应的三维系统具有有限的小动量贡献，并且不被 Mermin-Wagner 论证排除。

title: Interlayer-engineering of Charge Order Wave Vector in Kagome Metals
abstract: Charge orders in the kagome metals AV$_3$Sb$_5$ sit at the center of a rich phase diagram that also includes superconductivity, nematicity, and signatures of time-reversal-symmetry breaking. Yet even the basic question of which charge ordering wave vectors are intrinsic, and which are selected by dimensionality and lattice coupling, remains unsettled. Importantly, the microscopic origin of different charge orders and, in particular, the relationship between the robust bulk $2 \times 2$ charge order and the controversial $4 \times 1$ modulation, which is primarily resolved by surface probes, remains unresolved. Here, we use first-principles calculations to study the role of interlayer coupling in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ by tuning the interlayer separation from the monolayer limit to the bulk limit. In the monolayer AV$_3$Sb$_5$ (A = Rb, Cs), the phonon spectrum exhibits no instability at the M point; instead, the dominant lattice instability occurs at q = (1/4, 0, 0), consistent with a $4 \times 1$ modulation. As interlayer coupling increases in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$, an M-point phonon progressively softens and becomes unstable already near c = 12.24 Å, evolving into the strong $2 \times 2$ instability characteristic of the bulk. These results identify interlayer coupling as a control parameter at a fixed stoichiometry that links competing $4 \times 1$ and $2 \times 2$ tendencies, providing a unified framework for understanding why multiple charge-order wave vectors coexist and compete in kagome metals.
summary:
kagome 金属 AV$_3$Sb$_5$ 中的电荷顺序位于丰富的相图的中心，该相图还包括超导性、向列性和时间反转对称性破缺的特征。然而，甚至连哪些电荷排序波矢量是固有的、哪些是通过维数和晶格耦合来选择的基本问题仍然悬而未决。重要的是，不同电荷顺序的微观起源，特别是稳健的 $2 × 2$ 电荷顺序与有争议的 $4 × 1$ 调制（主要通过表面探针解决）之间的关系仍未得到解决。在这里，我们使用第一性原理计算，通过将层间分离从单层极限调整到体层极限来研究层间耦合在 CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ 中的作用。在单层AV$_3$Sb$_5$（A = Rb，Cs）中，声子谱在M点处没有表现出不稳定；相反，主要的晶格不稳定性发生在 q = (1/4, 0, 0) 处，与 $4 \times 1$ 调制一致。

随着 CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ 中层间耦合的增加，M 点声子逐渐软化并在 c = 12.24 Å 附近变得不稳定，演变成体块的强 $2 \times 2$ 不稳定性特征。这些结果将层间耦合确定为固定化学计量下的控制参数，该控制参数将竞争的 $4 × 1$ 和 $2 × 2$ 趋势联系起来，为理解为什么多个电荷阶波矢量在 kagome 金属中共存和竞争提供了一个统一的框架。

title: Neural Renormalization Group Flow for Percolation
abstract: Machine learning offers a possible route to data-driven real-space renormalization when the relevant observables are nonlocal and difficult to prescribe explicitly. We explore this idea for two-dimensional site percolation developping a supervised, scale-shared neural architecture. The model recursively applies the same learned coarse-graining rule across scales, producing a latent field from which the crossing probability is predicted, while a corresponding fine-graining decoder reconstructs the largest-cluster mask. Trained only on small lattices, the model extrapolates to substantially larger systems, recovers the spanning cluster with high fidelity, and produces observables obeying the expected finite-size scaling near the critical point. We observe that to get such performance it is key that the learned latent representation exhibits critical fluctuations and scale-dependent flows consistent with the renormalization-group structure of percolation.
summary: 当相关的可观察量是非局部的且难以明确规定时，机器学习提供了数据驱动的实空间重整化的可能途径。我们探索二维位点渗透的想法，开发有监督的、尺度共享的神经架构。该模型在各个尺度上递归地应用相同的学习粗粒度规则，产生一个潜场，从中预测交叉概率，而相应的细粒度解码器则重建最大簇掩码。该模型仅在小晶格上进行训练，可以外推到更大的系统，以高保真度恢复生成簇，并生成遵循临界点附近预期的有限尺寸缩放的可观测值。我们观察到，要获得这样的性能，学习的潜在表示表现出与渗流的重整化群结构一致的关键波动和尺度相关流是关键。

title: A novel Grand-Potential Phase-Field Lattice-Boltzmann model for multi-phase solidification with convection
abstract: Melt convection plays a critical role in microstructure evolution during alloy solidification, yet accurately capturing its interaction with moving solid-liquid interfaces remains a significant computational challenge, particularly in multi-phase, multi-component systems. In this work, we develop a computational framework that couples a Grand-Potential phase-field model with the Lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) to simulate convection-driven solidification within a unified and thermodynamically consistent formulation. The proposed approach rigorously enforces no-slip conditions at evolving solid-liquid interfaces, while fluid transport is solved using the standard single-relaxation-time Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook collision operator. The framework provides an efficient and robust methodology for resolving the coupled evolution of interfaces, solute transport, and fluid flow. The versatility of the proposed framework is demonstrated through simulations of dendritic and eutectic solidification under natural convection. The results show that convection significantly modifies solute segregation, destabilizes growth fronts, and induces oscillatory growth modes in both systems. These examples illustrate the capability of the proposed method to capture complex flow-induced morphological instabilities and provide new insights into the mechanisms governing convection-driven microstructure evolution in alloy solidification.
summary:
熔体对流在合金凝固过程中的微观结构演变中起着至关重要的作用，但准确捕获其与移动固液界面的相互作用仍然是一项重大的计算挑战，特别是在多相、多组分系统中。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个计算框架，将大势相场模型与格子玻尔兹曼方法 (LBM) 结合起来，以在统一且热力学一致的公式中模拟对流驱动的凝固。所提出的方法在不断发展的固液界面上严格执行无滑移条件，同时使用标准单弛豫时间 Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook 碰撞算子来解决流体传输。该框架提供了一种有效且稳健的方法来解决界面、溶质传输和流体流动的耦合演化。通过模拟自然对流下的枝晶和共晶凝固，证明了所提出框架的多功能性。结果表明，对流显着改变了溶质分离，破坏了生长前沿的稳定，并在两个系统中诱导了振荡生长模式。

这些例子说明了所提出的方法能够捕获复杂的流动引起的形态不稳定性，并为控制合金凝固中对流驱动的微观结构演化的机制提供新的见解。

title: Quenched activity induces nonuniversal scaling in nonreciprocal XY Models and surfaces
abstract: Active XY models and active surfaces are two paradigmatic nonequilibrium systems with distinct microscopic origins. We show that the hydrodynamic theories for a quenched-disordered nonreciprocal random bond two-dimensional XY model and an inversion-symmetric active surface tangentially advected by quenched velocities are identical. This theory predicts sub-logarithmic phase order in the XY model and sub- or super-logarithmic positional order in the surface for short-range disorder with nonuniversal exponents, which vary continuously with the degree of transversality of the disorder variance. We argue that the nonreciprocal random bond XY model can disorder through vortex proliferation.
summary: 主动 XY 模型和主动表面是两个具有不同微观起源的典型非平衡系统。我们证明了淬火无序非互易随机键二维 XY 模型和由淬火速度切向平流的反演对称活性表面的流体动力学理论是相同的。该理论预测了 XY 模型中的亚对数相序以及具有非通用指数的短程无序表面的亚对数位置序，这些无序随无序方差的横向程度连续变化。我们认为，不可逆随机键 XY 模型可能会通过涡流扩散而紊乱。

title: Electronic Structure and Band-Edge Character of Ga-Substituted $α$-Al$_2$O$_3$: A First-Principles Study
abstract: We present a first-principles density functional theory study of substitutional Ga incorporation in an $\alpha$-Al$_2$O$_3$-derived host, isolating chemical embedding effects without explicit geometric quantum confinement. Using a 30-atom $\alpha$-Al$_2$O$_3$ supercell with two substituted Ga atoms, we examine three nonequivalent Ga-pair configurations and combine configuration-dependent energetics, local structural analysis, Ga-centered distortion metrics, and electronic-structure calculations.% to establish the relationship between local coordination distortion and band-edge modification. The energetically preferred configuration is governed not solely by Ga--O bond expansion but by the ability of the host lattice to accommodate bond-length and angular distortions around substituted Ga centers. Ga incorporation narrows the band gap relative to pristine $\alpha$-Al$_2$O$_3$ without generating mid-gap states, primarily modifying the conduction-band manifold while preserving the oxygen-dominated valence edge. Band-edge charge densities and charge-density-difference maps show that the electronic response remains localized around the Ga-centered coordination environment. These results establish a chemically resolved baseline for understanding Ga incorporation in ultrawide-band-gap oxides and for future studies of confinement and interface effects in Ga-containing oxide nanostructures.
summary:
我们提出了第一性原理密度泛函理论研究 $\alpha$-Al$_2$O$_3$ 衍生主体中的替代 Ga 掺入，在没有明确几何量子限制的情况下隔离化学嵌入效应。使用具有两个取代的 Ga 原子的 30 原子 $\alpha$-Al$_2$O$_3$ 超晶胞，我们检查了三个非等价的 Ga 对配置，并结合配置相关的能量学、局域结构分析、Ga 中心畸变度量和电子结构计算。％建立局域配位畸变和带边修改之间的关系。能量上优选的构型不仅取决于Ga-O键扩展，还取决于主晶格适应取代Ga中心周围的键长和角度畸变的能力。 Ga 的掺入相对于原始 $\alpha$-Al$_2$O$_3$ 缩小了带隙，而不产生中带隙态，主要改变了导带流形，同时保留了氧主导的价态边缘。带边电荷密度和电荷密度差图表明电子响应仍然集中在以 Ga 为中心的配位环境周围。

这些结果为理解超宽带隙氧化物中的 Ga 掺入以及含 Ga 氧化物纳米结构中的限制和界面效应的未来研究建立了化学解析基线。

title: Localization Delocalization Transition in Diffusion with Adaptive Resetting
abstract: Stochastic resetting can localize diffusion and generate nonequilibrium steady states, but the conditions under which spatially dependent resetting produces localization remain unclear. Here, we establish a general classification for diffusion under adaptive resetting, where the resetting rate $r(x)$ depends on position. For rates with the asymptotic scaling $r(x)\sim |x|^\lambda$, we identify a sharp threshold at $\lambda=-2$. For $\lambda>-2$, the steady state is localized and exhibits stretched-exponential tails, whereas for $\lambda<-2$, resetting is asymptotically too weak to localize the particle. Precisely at the marginal scaling $r(x)\sim |x|^{-2}$, a qualitatively new regime emerges: the steady state develops power-law tails with a temperature-dependent exponent and exhibits a finite-temperature delocalization transition. Thus, inverse-square resetting plays the role of the logarithmic potential in equilibrium, establishing a nonequilibrium counterpart of the temperature-driven delocalization seen there.
summary: 随机重置可以使扩散局域化并产生非平衡稳态，但空间相关重置产生局域化的条件仍不清楚。在这里，我们建立了自适应重置下扩散的一般分类，其中重置率 $r(x)$ 取决于位置。对于渐进缩放 $r(x)\sim |x|^\lambda$ 的速率，我们在 $\lambda=-2$ 处确定一个尖锐阈值。对于 $\lambda>-2$，稳态是局部化的，并表现出拉伸的指数尾部，而对于 $\lambda<-2$，重置渐近太弱而无法局部化粒子。恰好在边际缩放 $r(x)\sim |x|^{-2}$ 处，出现了一种新的定性状态：稳态形成具有与温度相关的指数的幂律尾部，并表现出有限温度离域转变。因此，平方反比重置在平衡中发挥了对数势的作用，建立了温度驱动离域的非平衡对应物。

title: Occupation-Driven Josephson Diode in a Symmetric Junction
abstract: We propose a Josephson diode mechanism in which nonreciprocity arises not from a conventional asymmetric Andreev spectrum but from nonequilibrium occupation of the current-carrying states engineered by attached reservoirs. We realize this mechanism in a double-quantum-dot junction, where a phase-textured nonlocal reservoir acts as a quantum Zeno selector: rapid dissipation freezes out the bright state directly coupled to the jump operator $L$, while preserving an orthogonal dark Andreev channel whose supercurrent remains comparable to that of the lossless junction. In the infinite-gap limit, the steady-state current factorizes as $I_{\rm ss}=I_A P_\gamma$, so that even when the Andreev current $I_A$ is strictly reciprocal, the phase asymmetry of $P_\gamma$ alone can produce a Josephson diode effect through reservoir engineering. We further show that local Coulomb repulsion can drive the system toward a nearly ideal diode regime via a dark-pair resonance. Using Keldysh-Lindblad calculations, we demonstrate that our results remain robust for realistic junctions with a finite superconducting gap and dissipation.
summary: 我们提出了一种约瑟夫森二极管机制，其中非互易性不是由传统的不对称安德烈夫谱引起的，而是由附着的储层设计的载流状态的非平衡占据引起的。我们在双量子点结中实现了这种机制，其中相位纹理非局域存储库充当量子芝诺选择器：快速耗散冻结了直接耦合到跳跃算子$L$的亮态，同时保留了正交暗Andreev通道，其超电流仍然与无损结的超电流相当。在无限间隙极限下，稳态电流因式分解为$I_{\rm ss}=I_A P_\gamma$，因此即使当Andreev电流$I_A$严格互易时，仅$P_\gamma$的相位不对称性就可以通过油藏工程产生约瑟夫森二极管效应。我们进一步表明，局部库仑排斥可以通过暗对谐振驱动系统接近理想的二极管状态。使用 Keldysh-Lindblad 计算，我们证明我们的结果对于具有有限超导间隙和耗散的现实结仍然保持稳健。

title: Long-time Dynamics of Many-body Open Quantum Systems using Quantum Generating Functions
abstract: The interplay between coherent unitary evolution and environment-induced dissipation can give rise to a wide range of non-equilibrium dynamics in open quantum systems, ranging from interesting transport phenomena to dynamical phase transitions. However, accessing such long-time dynamics remains challenging for the existing methods developed for the simulation of many-body open quantum systems. We address this problem by developing a quantum generating function (QGF) formalism for open many-body systems for both ensemble-averaged dynamics governed by a Markovian quantum master equation and trajectory-resolved dynamics described by the quantum trajectory formalism, including quantum jumps, and quantum state diffusion. Our approach computes the dynamics of higher-order moments and fluctuation statistics without explicitly evolving the quantum state, thereby providing an efficient and scalable approach for investigating many-body open quantum systems. We demonstrate the versatility of the formalism by applying it to both the integrable open XXZ chain and the nonintegrable open next-nearest-neighbor XXZ spin chain, where it uncovers distinct initial state dependent long-time transport regimes. Our work establishes quantum generating functions as an efficient and scalable framework for investigating long-time dynamics in open quantum many-body systems.
summary:
相干酉演化和环境引起的耗散之间的相互作用可以在开放量子系统中产生广泛的非平衡动力学，从有趣的输运现象到动态相变。然而，对于为模拟多体开放量子系统而开发的现有方法来说，获取如此长时间的动态仍然具有挑战性。我们通过为开放多体系统开发量子生成函数（QGF）形式来解决这个问题，该系统既适用于由马尔可夫量子主方程控制的系综平均动力学，也适用于由量子轨迹形式描述的轨迹解析动力学，包括量子跳跃和量子态扩散。我们的方法计算高阶矩的动力学和涨落统计量，而无需显式演化量子态，从而为研究多体开放量子系统提供有效且可扩展的方法。

我们通过将其应用于可积开放 XXZ 链和不可积开放次近邻 XXZ 自旋链来证明形式主义的多功能性，其中它揭示了不同的初始状态依赖的长期传输机制。我们的工作将量子生成函数建立为一个有效且可扩展的框架，用于研究开放量子多体系统中的长期动力学。

title: Asymmetric Ions in Solution are Similar to Active Brownian Particles
abstract: Molecular dynamics simulations of electrolyte ions with charge shifted by the distance $d$ from the ion geometrical center have shown that mechanical equilibrium in the ion's body frame is not established beyond a critical shift distance $d^*$. A sharp crossover to a non-zero body-frame force occurs due to frustration of water molecules failing to compensate the electrostatic pull with a local density augmentation. A solution ion with asymmetric charge experiences a net body-frame force similar to self-propelled motion of active-matter Brownian particles. Thermal equilibrium and zero laboratory-frame force are still maintained, but the diffusion constant drops significantly ($\sim 400$ times) when the charge displacement crosses the threshold value $d^*$. Alternative routes to the diffusion constant become inequivalent and the diffusion constant from the mean-squared displacement is much higher than those from velocity and force correlation functions.
summary: 对电荷从离子几何中心移动距离 $d$ 的电解质离子进行的分子动力学模拟表明，超过临界移动距离 $d^*$ 后，离子体框架中的机械平衡不会建立。由于水分子的挫败无法通过局部密度增加来补偿静电拉力，因此会发生与非零身体框架力的急剧交叉。具有不对称电荷的溶液离子会经历类似于活性物质布朗粒子的自推进运动的净体框架力。仍然保持热平衡和零实验室框架力，但当电荷位移超过阈值 $d^*$ 时，扩散常数显着下降（$\sim 400$ 倍）。扩散常数的替代路径变得不等价，并且均方位移的扩散常数远高于速度和力相关函数的扩散常数。

title: Crystal Structure Prototype Identification via Element-Mapped Rotation-Invariant Descriptors
abstract: We present a method for identifying crystal structure prototypes from local atomic environments. A center atom and its neighbors within a distance-normalized cutoff are mapped to anonymous element types (A/B/C/D) by proximity, and a NEP-style descriptor-radial Chebyshev moments plus contracted spherical-harmonic (S-vector) invariants-is computed per type block. The descriptor is rotation-invariant by construction (MLFF-style contraction with analytic normalization constants), so no rotation augmentation is needed. A trainable block-diagonal projection compresses the 316-dimensional raw basis into a 168-dimensional learned descriptor fed to a three-layer MLP. The model classifies each atom into one of 271 AFLOW crystal structure prototypes or the amorphous class (272 classes), reaching 99.38% accuracy on 538,190 per-atom samples. The full pipeline (descriptor extraction + inference) runs on a single CPU core at 3.9 s per 10,000 atoms, making it suitable for website deployment.
summary: 我们提出了一种从局部原子环境中识别晶体结构原型的方法。中心原子及其在距离归一化截止范围内的邻居通过邻近度映射到匿名元素类型 (A/B/C/D)，并且每个类型块计算 NEP 样式描述符-径向切比雪夫矩加上收缩的球谐（S 向量）不变量。该描述符在构造上是旋转不变的（具有分析归一化常数的 MLFF 式收缩），因此不需要旋转增强。可训练的块对角投影将 316 维原始基础压缩为 168 维学习描述符，馈送到三层 MLP。该模型将每个原子分类为 271 个 AFLOW 晶体结构原型或非晶类（272 类）之一，在 538,190 个每个原子样本上达到 99.38% 的准确率。完整的管道（描述符提取+推理）在单个CPU核心上以每10,000个原子3.9秒的速度运行，使其适合网站部署。

title: Grain-Boundary Premelting in High-Entropy Transition Metal Carbides
abstract: Grain-boundary segregation and thermally induced interfacial disordering were investigated in four high-entropy transition metal carbides using Monte Carlo (MC) sampling and molecular dynamics (MD) with the universal MACE-OMAT-0 machine-learning interatomic potential. MC sampling segregated the group-VI element (Cr, Mo, or W) and Zr to grain boundaries, where the group-VI content reached approximately 45 at.%, consistent with STEM-EDS observations. During MD heating, the grain-boundary Lindemann index, a normalized measure of interatomic distance fluctuations, reached the liquid-like threshold of $\delta=0.15$ near $1390^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ for the Cr-containing carbides, $1660^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ for Mo, and $1890^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ for W, while the grain interiors remained below the threshold. A chemically random (Cr,Hf,Ta,Ti,Zr)C reference crossed about $60^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ later and showed less boundary-localized disorder, highlighting the role of interfacial chemistry in premelting. Species-resolved displacements showed enhanced grain-boundary mobility, particularly for carbon. Overall, Cr-rich interfaces showed the earliest and most extensive premelting-like response, followed by Mo- and W-containing boundaries.
summary:
使用蒙特卡罗 (MC) 采样和分子动力学 (MD) 以及通用 MACE-OMAT-0 机器学习原子间势，研究了四种高熵过渡金属碳化物的晶界偏析和热致界面无序。 MC 采样将 VI 族元素（Cr、Mo 或 W）和 Zr 偏析到晶界，其中 VI 族元素含量达到约 45 at.%，与 STEM-EDS 观察结果一致。在MD加热过程中，晶界林德曼指数（原子间距离波动的归一化测量）达到了类液体阈值$\delta=0.15$，含Cr碳化物接近$1390^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$，Mo$1660^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$，W$1890^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$，而晶粒内部仍低于阈值。化学随机 (Cr,Hf,Ta,Ti,Zr)C 参考随后跨越约 $60^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$，并显示出较少的边界局部无序，突出了界面化学在预熔化中的作用。物种解决的位移显示出增强的晶界流动性，特别是碳。

总体而言，富铬界面表现出最早和最广泛的类预熔化响应，其次是含钼和含钨界面。

title: 3D Cloud Component Analysis of Atomic Structures
abstract: We present a method for decomposing atomic structures into physically meaningful components by converting discrete atomic coordinates into continuous three-dimensional density fields. Each element is represented by a Gaussian-smeared density map with values ranging from 0 to 1, computed efficiently through a bin-then-blur approach with periodic boundary conditions. The sum of all element densities, truncated at unity, defines the material region; its complement defines the vacuum. Every voxel is first assigned a chemical formula from the set of elements present above a threshold; the resulting formula map is then cleaned so that only regions with a genuine bulk interior-measured by the Euclidean distance to their own boundary-survive as components. Thin surface terminations (e.g., a Ga monolayer on GaAs) and one-to-two-voxel boundary layers between two crystals are absorbed by the neighboring stable region, so the decomposition contains exactly the bulk-like chemical-formula components and the vacuum, with no surface or interface components. For each component we determine the crystal phase with a neural prototype classifier: one phase if the trusted interior atoms vote unanimously, two phases (e.g., crystalline and amorphous Si) if they split into two confident groups, in which case the component is divided into two. Interfaces and surfaces are then derived as boundaries-material-material and material-vacuum-and every atom is labeled bulk, surface, interface, or vertex, with vertex reserved for geometric corners of a component. Inside crystalline components, inner defects are detected from coordination-number and local-density deviations. We demonstrate the approach on Si/GaAs and Si/SiO2 heterojunctions, crystalline/amorphous silicon junctions, vacancy-containing crystals, and bulk crystals.
summary:
我们提出了一种通过将离散原子坐标转换为连续三维密度场来将原子结构分解为物理上有意义的组件的方法。每个元素均由值范围为 0 到 1 的高斯涂抹密度图表示，通过具有周期性边界条件的先合并后模糊方法进行有效计算。所有元素密度的总和（按单位截断）定义了材料区域；它的补数定义了真空。首先为每个体素分配一个来自阈值以上元素集合的化学式；然后对所得的公式图进行清理，以便只有具有真正的块状内部（通过到其自身边界的欧几里德距离测量）的区域才能作为组件生存。薄的表面终端（例如，GaAs 上的 Ga 单层）和两个晶体之间的一对二体素边界层被相邻的稳定区域吸收，因此分解完全包含块状化学式成分和真空，没有表面或界面成分。

对于每个组件，我们使用神经原型分类器确定晶相：如果可信内部原子一致投票，则为一相；如果它们分裂成两个置信组，则为两相（例如，结晶和非晶硅），在这种情况下，组件被分为两个。然后将界面和表面导出为边界（材料-材料和材料-真空），并且每个原子都被标记为体、表面、界面或顶点，并为组件的几何角保留顶点。在晶体成分内部，通过配位数和局部密度偏差检测内部缺陷。我们在 Si/GaAs 和 Si/SiO2 异质结、晶体/非晶硅结、含空位晶体和块体晶体上演示了该方法。

title: Grain Boundary Phase Transitions Enable Diffusionless Climb of Disconnections
abstract: Dislocation-grain boundary (GB) interactions govern the mechanical response of polycrystalline materials by controlling dislocation absorption, transmission, and interfacial plasticity. While disconnection climb is conventionally understood to require the absorption or emission of point defects supplied through long range bulk diffusion, GBs possess intrinsic configurational degrees of freedom associated with their atomic structure, or microstate, that may provide an alternative mechanism. Here, using bicrystallography and molecular dynamics simulations, we investigate the interaction of shear dislocation loops with the [1 1 0](-5 5 14) symmetric tilt grain boundary in Al. We show that dislocation absorption generates a mobile extrinsic disconnection with a nonzero climb component that propagates conservatively along the interface without long-range bulk point-defect transport. Its motion is accompanied by a localized GB phase transformation mediated by cooperative atomic rearrangements within the GB core, producing successive metastable GB microstates. These findings establish a direct coupling between lattice dislocations and GB phase evolution and reveal a conservative mechanism for disconnection climb fundamentally distinct from conventional vacancy-mediated climb.
summary:
位错-晶界 (GB) 相互作用通过控制位错吸收、传输和界面塑性来控制多晶材料的机械响应。虽然断线攀爬通常被认为需要吸收或发射通过长程体扩散提供的点缺陷，但晶界拥有与其原子结构或微观状态相关的内在构型自由度，这可能提供一种替代机制。在这里，我们利用双晶体学和分子动力学模拟，研究了剪切位错环与 Al 中 [1 1 0](-5 5 14) 对称倾斜晶界的相互作用。我们表明，位错吸收会产生具有非零爬升分量的移动外在断开，该非零爬升分量沿着界面保守传播，而没有长程体点缺陷传输。它的运动伴随着由晶界核心内合作原子重排介导的局部晶界相变，产生连续的亚稳态晶界微观状态。

这些发现建立了晶格位错和晶界相演化之间的直接耦合，并揭示了一种与传统空位介导的攀爬根本不同的保守的断开攀爬机制。

title: Nonparametric multiscale modeling of boundary lubrication: hexadecane in highly pressurized gold asperity contacts
abstract: Boundary lubrication is governed by molecular processes at the sliding interface that are inaccessible to classical continuum descriptions. While molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can resolve these processes in atomistic detail, incorporating their output into engineering-scale models through semi-empirical constitutive laws becomes increasingly difficult as confinement approaches the molecular scale. Here, we apply a nonparametric multiscale framework based on Gaussian process (GP) regression to model boundary lubrication of hexadecane confined between gold surfaces under pressures up to 1 GPa and gap heights down to 1.4 nm. The GP surrogates are trained on nonequilibrium MD simulations of the confined fluid and directly provide stress predictions to a continuum thin-film solver, circumventing the need for fixed-form constitutive laws. The framework naturally captures molecular phenomena such as density layering, viscosity changes, and the strongly nonlinear wall slip that dominates the frictional response at high pressures and small gap heights. Our results reproduce the atomistic benchmark data of Codrignani et al., demonstrating that nonparametric surrogate models offer a flexible and physically transparent route toward predictive continuum modeling of boundary lubrication.
summary:
边界润滑由滑动界面处的分子过程控制，这是经典连续介质描述所无法达到的。虽然分子动力学（MD）模拟可以在原子细节上解决这些过程，但随着限制接近分子尺度，通过半经验本构定律将其输出纳入工程规模模型变得越来越困难。在这里，我们应用基于高斯过程 (GP) 回归的非参数多尺度框架来模拟金表面之间限制的十六烷在压力高达 1 GPa 和间隙高度低至 1.4 nm 的情况下的边界润滑。 GP 代理接受了受限流体的非平衡 MD 模拟训练，并直接向连续薄膜求解器提供应力预测，从而避免了对固定形式本构定律的需求。该框架自然地捕获了分子现象，例如密度分层、粘度变化以及在高压和小间隙高度下主导摩擦响应的强非线性壁滑移。

我们的结果再现了 Codrignani 等人的原子基准数据，证明非参数替代模型为边界润滑的预测连续体建模提供了灵活且物理透明的途径。

title: A continuous confinement-deconfinement transition in a triangular quantum magnet
abstract: A continuous transition between phases hosting distinct excitations---bosonic magnons versus fermionic spinons---is a long-sought phenomenon in quantum magnetism, analogous to the confinement--deconfinement transition in quantum chromodynamics. We report evidence for such a transition in the triangular-lattice antiferromagnet TlYbS$_2$. Antiferromagnetic order develops below $T_\mathrm{N} \approx 0.53\,\mathrm{K}$. A $c$-axis field suppresses this order, driving the system into a gapless quantum spin liquid with a spinon Fermi surface above $\mu_0 H_\mathrm{c} \approx 3\,\mathrm{T}$, evidenced by a finite residual linear term in thermal conductivity, a Pauli-like susceptibility, and a temperature-independent NMR Knight shift. Approaching $H_\mathrm{c}$ from above, the scattering rate of itinerant excitations is strongly enhanced while their density of states shows no critical enhancement, atypical of conventional magnetic quantum criticality. These results point to a continuous confinement--deconfinement transition governed by fractionalized excitations beyond the Ginzburg--Landau paradigm.
summary: 具有不同激发的相之间的连续转变（玻色子磁振子与费米子自旋子）是量子磁性中长期寻求的现象，类似于量子色动力学中的限制-解除限制转变。我们报告了三角晶格反铁磁体 TlYbS$_2$ 中这种转变的证据。反铁磁序在 $T_\mathrm{N} \approx 0.53\,\mathrm{K}$ 以下发展。 $c$ 轴场抑制了这种顺序，将系统驱动为无间隙量子自旋液体，其自旋费米面高于 $\mu_0 H_\mathrm{c} \approx 3\,\mathrm{T}$，由热导率中的有限剩余线性项、类泡利磁化率和与温度无关的 NMR Knight 位移证明。从上方接近$H_\mathrm{c}$，巡回激发的散射率大大增强，而它们的态密度没有显示出临界增强，这与传统磁量子临界性不同。这些结果表明，在金兹堡-朗道范式之外，由分段激励控制的连续限制-解除限制转变。

title: Trapping $e/4$ quasiparticles in bilayer graphene
abstract: Measuring the charge of the quasiparticles hosted by even-denominator fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states is essential to identify the topology of their ground state. Here, we use a gate-defined antidot in bilayer graphene, with an additional gate to control only the antidot potential, to measure the charge of the quasiparticles trapped around it in even-denominator FQH states. We observe a localized charge of $e/4$ at $\nu=-5/2$, $-1/2$, and $3/2$, consistent with the minimal excitation expected for leading candidate even-denominator ground states, and $e/3$ at the hole-conjugate state $\nu=2/3$. We further show that increasing the coupling between the antidot-bound states and extended edge states drives a crossover between two regimes, characterized by the minimal-excitation gate-voltage period and approximately twice that period, respectively. We discuss two possible explanations for this crossover: quasiparticle bunching and a crossover between distinct antidot transport regimes. Our results, together with previous observations of the daughter states, show that the even-denominator FQH states in bilayer graphene are compatible with a non-Abelian ground state, and that their quasiparticles can be localized around a quantum Hall antidot, a necessary ingredient for topological quantum computation.
summary:
测量偶分母分数量子霍尔 (FQH) 态所承载的准粒子的电荷对于识别其基态拓扑至关重要。在这里，我们在双层石墨烯中使用门定义的反点，并使用一个额外的门来仅控制反点电势，以测量在偶分母 FQH 状态下捕获在其周围的准粒子的电荷。我们在 $\nu=-5/2$、$-1/2$ 和 $3/2$ 处观察到 $e/4$ 的局部电荷，与主要候选偶分母基态预期的最小激励一致，在空穴共轭态 $\nu=2/3$ 处观察到 $e/3$。我们进一步表明，增加反点束缚态和扩展边缘态之间的耦合会驱动两种状态之间的交叉，其特征分别是最小激励栅极电压周期和大约两倍的周期。我们讨论了这种交叉的两种可能的解释：准粒子聚集和不同解点传输机制之间的交叉。

我们的结果以及之前对子态的观察表明，双层石墨烯中的偶分母 FQH 态与非阿贝尔基态兼容，并且它们的准粒子可以局域于量子霍尔反点周围，这是拓扑量子计算的必要成分。

title: Band's Geometry Origin of Quantum Spin Transport Phenomena
abstract: We develop a geometric description of spin-dependent transport based on the local geometric structure of electronic bands and the Fermi surfaces. For quasi-two-dimensional systems, we show that hyperbolic regions of constant-energy surfaces generate a geometrical contribution to the Fermi velocity that couples naturally to electron spin and produces a spin-current response. We further show that, in the presence of time-reversal symmetry, the algebra of spin operators can be related to the exterior algebra of the band's tangent space, providing an additional geometric interpretation of spin in momentum space. This framework motivates a symplectic description of spin-separated transport on Fermi surfaces and its extension to three-dimensional band manifolds through contact geometry. Our results establish a direct connection between Fermi-surface geometry and intrinsic spin transport.
summary: 我们基于电子能带和费米面的局部几何结构开发了自旋相关输运的几何描述。对于准二维系统，我们表明恒定能量表面的双曲区域对费米速度产生几何贡献，该速度自然耦合到电子自旋并产生自旋电流响应。我们进一步证明，在时间反演对称性存在的情况下，自旋算子的代数可以与能带切线空间的外代数相关，从而为动量空间中的自旋提供额外的几何解释。该框架激发了费米表面上自旋分离输运的辛描述及其通过接触几何扩展到三维带流形。我们的结果建立了费米表面几何结构和本征自旋输运之间的直接联系。

title: Exact Stiffness and Dynamical Responses from Fock-Space Fragmentation
abstract: Exactly solvable quantum many-body models are rare, and even when their spectra are algebraically organized, dynamical responses generally remain difficult to obtain because they probe an extensive number of excited states. Here we show that quantum geometric nesting (QGN) models admit an unusually strong form of solvability rooted in \emph{Fock-space fragmentation}: excitations on top of the exact frustration-free ground states decouple into Krylov subspaces with a fixed number of particle and hole operators, and hence remain dynamically invariant. Exploiting this structure, we prove that the stiffness of the spontaneously broken continuous symmetry in QGN models is exactly equal to its variational value in the Gaussian manifold, confirming a conjecture from quantum many-body bootstrap~\cite{GaoHanKhalaf2026}. The proof shows that an infinitesimal phase twist couples the ground state only to the one-particle, one-hole fragment, which coincides with the tangent space of the ground state within the variational manifold, thereby making the variational curvature exact. More generally, perturbations whose action remains within a fixed Fock-space fragment have response functions determined exactly by the corresponding few-body sector, enabling exact access to quantities including static susceptibility, optical conductivity, dynamical structure factors, and single-particle Green's functions.
summary:
精确可解的量子多体模型很少见，即使它们的光谱是代数组织的，动态响应通常仍然难以获得，因为它们探测了大量的激发态。在这里，我们表明量子几何嵌套（QGN）模型承认一种异常强大的可解性形式，其根源在于\emph{Fock空间碎片}：精确无挫败基态之上的激发解耦到具有固定数量的粒子和空穴算子的克雷洛夫子空间中，因此保持动态不变。利用这种结构，我们证明了 QGN 模型中自发破缺连续对称性的刚度恰好等于其在高斯流形中的变分值，证实了量子多体自举的猜想~\cite{GaoHanKhalaf2026}。证明表明，无穷小的相位扭曲仅将基态耦合到单粒子、单孔片段，其与变分流形内基态的切空间重合，从而使变分曲率精确。

更一般地说，其作用保持在固定福克空间片段内的扰动具有由相应的少体扇区精确确定的响应函数，从而能够精确获取包括静态磁化率、光导率、动态结构因子和单粒子格林函数在内的物理量。

title: Metallogenic quantum criticality: Fermi surface nucleation at transitions between gapped phases
abstract: Continuous quantum phase transitions in interacting many-body systems exhibit universal phenomena that are largely independent of microscopic details. An organizing principle distilled from canonical examples such as the magnetic transition in Ising models is that the low-energy physics of transitions between gapped phases is governed by scale-invariant quantum field theories with gapless degrees of freedom at isolated points in momentum space. In this paper, we show that this principle can fail in a radical way: an entire gapless Fermi surface can emerge at a quantum critical point separating two fully gapped insulators. These exotic phase transitions are dubbed \textit{metallogenic quantum critical points} (MGQCP). We construct a controlled family of effective field theories for MGQCPs between distinct fractional Chern insulators and propose a periodically modulated quantum Hall bilayer as a minimal microscopic setting. The critical theory exhibits an unusual mixture of physical signatures: while transport and compressibility follow scaling laws compatible with a conformal field theory, the electron spectral function develops a power-law non-analyticity at the Fermi momentum, characteristic of non-Fermi-liquid metals. We discuss how the concept of MGQCP may shed new light on critical phenomena in moire materials with tunable Chern bands. More generally, our results point to a broader class of quantum critical phenomena in which extended manifolds of gapless excitations emerge in momentum space despite being absent in both neighboring phases.
summary:
相互作用的多体系统中的连续量子相变表现出很大程度上独立于微观细节的普遍现象。从伊辛模型中的磁跃迁等典型例子中提炼出的一个组织原则是，带隙相之间转变的低能物理是由尺度不变的量子场论控制的，在动量空间的孤立点上具有无带隙自由度。在本文中，我们证明了这一原理可能会以一种根本的方式失败：整个无间隙费米表面可以在分隔两个完全有间隙绝缘体的量子临界点处出现。这些奇特的相变被称为 \textit{成矿量子临界点} (MGQCP)。我们为不同分数陈绝缘体之间的 MGQCP 构建了一系列受控的有效场论，并提出了周期性调制的量子霍尔双层作为最小微观设置。

临界理论表现出一种不寻常的物理特征混合：虽然传输和压缩性遵循与共形场理论兼容的标度定律，但电子谱函数在费米动量处发展出幂律非解析性，这是非费米液态金属的特征。我们讨论了 MGQCP 的概念如何为具有可调陈氏带的莫尔材料中的关键现象提供新的视角。更一般地说，我们的结果指出了更广泛的一类量子临界现象，其中在动量空间中出现了扩展的无间隙激发流形，尽管在两个相邻相中都不存在。

title: The facts on quantum self-dual Einstein gravity and self-dual Yang-Mills theory
abstract: Self-dual Einstein gravity is a one-loop exact, UV and IR finite, diffeomorphism invariant, non-unitary theory of quantum gravity in four dimensions. The only non-trivial amplitudes are the one-loop-all-plus amplitudes, and they are equal to those of pure Einstein gravity. In these notes we review SDG and SDYM pedagogically. We walk the reader through key calculations, fill in some gaps in the literature, and point out directions for future research. Topics include: derivation of the self-dual actions from the full Einstein gravity/YM actions in lightcone gauge, decoupling of ghosts, Berends-Giele currents, vanishing of tree-level-one-minus amplitudes, celestial $Lw_{1+\infty}$ symmetry, perturbiners, double-off-shell current calculation of one-loop-all-plus SDYM and SDG amplitudes, dimension shifting, unitarity cuts, the BDPR gravity formula, one-loop color ordering, and the covariant formulations of the self-dual theories as well as their their gauge fixing. We also review some selected results from the celestial holography program, and briefly comment on an all-n expression for the one-loop-one-minus gravity amplitudes.
summary: 自对偶爱因斯坦引力是四维量子引力的单环精确、紫外和红外有限、微分同胚不变、非酉理论。唯一不平凡的振幅是单环全加振幅，它们等于纯爱因斯坦引力的振幅。在这些笔记中，我们从教学角度回顾了 SDG 和 SDYM。我们引导读者完成关键计算，填补文献中的一些空白，并指出未来研究的方向。主题包括：从光锥测量仪中完整的爱因斯坦引力/YM 作用推导出自对偶作用、鬼魂解耦、Berends-Giele 电流、树级一负振幅消失、天体 $Lw_{1+\infty}$ 对称性、扰动器、单环全加 SDYM 和 SDG 振幅的双离壳电流计算、维度转换、酉割、BDPR 引力公式、单环颜色排序、自对偶理论的协变公式及其规范固定。我们还回顾了天体全息程序的一些选定结果，并简要评论了一环一负重力振幅的全n表达式。

title: Renormalization in Liouville gravity and stochastic inflation
abstract: Motivated by inflation and Liouville theory, we consider random $d$-dimensional geometries characterized by an overall scale factor $ds^2 = e^{2 \zeta} dx^2 $ given in terms of a random Gaussian field $\zeta(x)$ with logarithmic correlations. We discuss aspects of the renormalization of the volume element $e^{d \zeta }$, connecting well-known Liouville theory formulas (KPZ) and inflationary ones. By starting from a fixed physical cutoff and coarse-graining operators to a fixed fiducial cutoff, defined via the flat metric $dx^2$, we provide a direct physical derivation of the KPZ scaling relation. We point out that the same renormalization problem arises in stochastic inflation, where it is modeled by Brownian motion of the inflaton field. We show that the breakdown of the renormalization of the Liouville volume when the fluctuation amplitude exceeds a critical value corresponds to the transition to eternal inflation. In $d = 2$, this matches the familiar $c_m = 1$ barrier in Liouville gravity. We also discuss connections to mathematical probabilistic approaches to random surfaces.
summary: 受通货膨胀和刘维尔理论的启发，我们考虑随机 $d$ 维几何，其特征是总体比例因子 $ds^2 = e^{2 \zeta} dx^2 $ 以具有对数相关性的随机高斯场 $\zeta(x)$ 给出。我们讨论体积元素 $e^{d \zeta }$ 重整化的各个方面，将著名的刘维尔理论公式 (KPZ) 和通货膨胀公式联系起来。通过从固定的物理截止值和粗粒度算子开始到通过平面度量 $dx^2$ 定义的固定基准截止值，我们提供了 KPZ 缩放关系的直接物理推导。我们指出，随机暴胀中也会出现同样的重整化问题，它是通过暴胀场的布朗运动来建模的。我们证明，当波动幅度超过临界值时，刘维尔体积重正化的崩溃对应于向永恒暴胀的过渡。在 $d = 2$ 中，这与刘维尔引力中熟悉的 $c_m = 1$ 势垒相匹配。我们还讨论了与随机表面的数学概率方法的联系。

title: Positivity in energy correlators and the event distribution formula
abstract: Energy correlators are universal observables, well defined across a wide range of theories and spacetime dimensions, from gauge theory and conformal field theory to string theory. Energy correlators are constrained by three fundamental properties: pointwise positivity of the energy flux, global positivity originating from their interpretation as state norms in a unitary theory, and energy conservation organizing multi-point energy correlators into an infinite consistent hierarchy. We argue that the most general solution to the infinite hierarchy positivity problem of energy correlators is given by the event distribution formula, which expresses energy correlators as moments of the measure on the space of probability measures on the celestial sphere. We work out in detail implications of positivity for two- and three-point energy correlators and show that it implies nontrivial two-sided bounds on their multipole expansion coefficients. The bounds obtained by requiring consistency of the infinite hierarchy of energy correlators are strictly stronger than those obtained by imposing positivity of the two- and three-point correlators alone. For the low-spin multipole coefficients studied in the paper, the derived bounds are optimal in the sense that their extrema are realized by finite mixtures of finite-particle events. We further demonstrate consequences of positivity in energy correlators in collider physics and conformal field theories.
summary:
能量相关器是通用的可观测量，在从规范理论、共形场论到弦理论的各种理论和时空维度上都有明确的定义。能量相关器受到三个基本属性的约束：能量通量的逐点正性、源自其解释为统一理论中的状态规范的全局正性，以及将多点能量相关器组织成无限一致层次结构的能量守恒。我们认为，能量相关器的无限层次正性问题的最一般解决方案是由事件分布公式给出的，该公式将能量相关器表示为天球概率测度空间上的测度矩。我们详细计算出正性对两点和三点能量相关器的影响，并表明它意味着其多极展开系数的非平凡两侧界限。通过要求能量相关器的无限层级的一致性所获得的界限严格地强于通过单独施加两点和三点相关器的正性所获得的界限。

对于本文研究的低自旋多极系数，导出的边界是最优的，因为它们的极值是通过有限粒子事件的有限混合实现的。我们进一步证明了对撞机物理和共形场论中能量相关器的积极影响。

title: Why Cooper pairs live in AdS2: a spectral analysis of the Yukawa-SYK model
abstract: We establish the spectral foundation of the geometric formulation of Cooper pairing in the Yukawa--Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model. Starting from the large-$N$ bilocal effective action, we derive the Gaussian fluctuation kernel in the even-frequency spin-singlet Cooper channel. Following the construction of Maldacena and Stanford, we determine the kernel eigenvalue $k\left(h\right)$ analytically for arbitrary conformal weight $h$ and resolve the pairing fluctuations into the continuous and discrete sectors of the associated de-Sitter space Laplacian. We show that the superconducting instability and the universal low-energy fluctuations near it reside entirely in the continuous scattering sector, while the discrete modes remain non-critical. Expanding the kernel about the lowest continuum mode yields a Klein--Gordon action on ${\rm dS}_2$, restricted to the continuous spectral subspace. This is precisely the subspace on which the inverse Radon transform to ${\rm AdS}_2$ is well defined. The projected bilocal Cooper-pair field can therefore be mapped onto a scalar matter field propagating in ${\rm AdS}_2$, without requiring any further spectral restriction on the bulk theory. Our results provide the missing microscopic justification for the projection implicit in earlier holographic formulations and clarify how a local bulk field emerges from the bilocal pairing theory.
summary:
我们建立了Yukawa--Sachdev--Ye-Kitaev模型中Cooper配对几何公式的谱基础。从大$N$双局域有效作用出发，我们推导了偶频自旋单线Cooper通道中的高斯涨落核。在构建 Maldacena 和斯坦福之后，我们通过分析确定任意保角权重 $h$ 的核特征值 $k\left(h\right)$ 并将配对波动解析为相关的去西特空间拉普拉斯算子的连续和离散扇区。我们表明，超导不稳定性和其附近普遍的低能涨落完全存在于连续散射部分，而离散模式仍然是非关键的。围绕最低连续模式展开内核会产生 ${\rm dS}_2$ 上的 Klein--Gordon 作用，仅限于连续谱子空间。这正是定义了 ${\rm AdS}_2$ 的 Radon 逆变换的子空间。因此，投影的双局域库珀对场可以映射到在 ${\rm AdS}_2$ 中传播的标量物质场，而不需要对体理论进行任何进一步的谱限制。

我们的结果为早期全息公式中隐含的投影提供了缺失的微观理由，并阐明了局部体场如何从双局部配对理论中出现。

title: Inner products and closed universes
abstract: We study overlaps of late-time states in semiclassical de Sitter quantum gravity. In a family of deformations of de Sitter JT gravity, we compute the no-boundary wavefunction to one-loop and derive the ultralocal late-time measure. The one-universe contribution to the norm is exactly eight times the sphere amplitude, so the pairing used by the Lorentzian measure differs from that implicit in Euclidean gravity. After summing over disconnected final universes, the no-boundary norm exponentiates the one-universe result, giving $\langle \!\langle \text{HH}|\text{HH}\rangle\!\rangle \approx \exp(8Z_{\rm sphere})$ rather than the sum over closed geometries, $Z_{\rm closed}\approx \exp(Z_{\rm sphere})$. We also review an analogous mismatch in Einstein gravity with positive cosmological constant, where the late-time no-boundary norm vanishes at one-loop, differing from the Euclidean sphere amplitude. We discuss the implications for cutting and gluing in perturbative gravity, and features that arise when extending this construction to sums over topologies.
summary: 我们研究半经典德西特量子引力中晚期状态的重叠。在德西特 JT 引力的一系列变形中，我们将无边界波函数计算为单环，并推导出超局域后期测量。单宇宙对范数的贡献恰好是球体振幅的八倍，因此洛伦兹测度所使用的配对与欧几里得引力中隐含的配对不同。对断开连接的最终宇宙求和后，无边界范数对一宇宙结果求幂，给出 $\langle \!\langle \text{HH}|\text{HH}\rangle\!\rangle \approx \exp(8Z_{\rm sphere})$ 而不是闭合几何上的总和，$Z_{\rm close}\approx \exp(Z_{\rm sphere})$。我们还回顾了爱因斯坦引力与正宇宙学常数的类似失配，其中晚期无边界范数在单环处消失，这与欧几里得球体振幅不同。我们讨论了微扰引力中切割和粘合的含义，以及将这种结构扩展到拓扑上的求和时出现的特征。

title: Contact Structure-induced Symplectic Nearly Half-Flat $SU(3)$ Structure in Finite-$N$ Thermal ${\cal M}$-Theory
abstract: The ${\cal M}$-theory dual of thermal QCD-like theories constructed in arXiv:1306.4339 , 2004.07259 involves, as shown in arXiv:2211.13186 , a closed $G_2$-structure seven-fold $\mathcal{M}_7$ supporting Contact 3-Structures (C3S) that induce a ``transverse'' $SU(3)$-structure. We prove that this induced structure belongs to the symplectic nearly half-flat (S(nearly)HF) class: $d\omega_\Phi=0$ exactly, while $d\Omega_+$ is suppressed as $\mathcal{O}(e^{-N^{1/3}/\mathcal{O}(1)})$ in the infrared "MQGP limit", leaving $W_\Phi^{SU(3)}=W_2^-$ as the sole non-vanishing Chiossi--Salamon torsion class and completing the $G$-structure classification of the MQGP dual initiated in arXiv:1507.02692 , 2004.07259 , 2211.13186 . As a physical application, Kaluza--Klein reduction of the eleven-dimensional Hodge dual of the differential of the $G_2$-structure positive three-form on $\mathcal{M}_7$, organised through the $G_2$/S(nearly)HF torsion data, yields a radial ``magnetic field'' $\mathcal{B}_{\rm KK}(r)$ whose squared norm factorises exactly into external and internal factors. $\mathcal{B}_{\rm KK}(r)$ satisfies a Bessel-type ODE with a regular singular point at the horizon; normalisability and infrared regularity select $J_2$, with harmonicity of the aforementioned internal factor recovered from the large-$N$ suppression. $\mathcal{B}_{\rm KK}$ is related to the magnetic field of the type~IIA flavour $D6$-branes via a non-linear power law, furnishing a top-down holographic mechanism for generating weak magnetic fields in finite-temperature string theory.
summary:
arXiv:1306.4339 , 2004.07259 中构建的类热 QCD 理论的 ${\cal M}$ 理论对偶涉及，如 arXiv:2211.13186 所示，一个封闭的 $G_2$ 结构七重 $\mathcal{M}_7$ 支持接触 3 结构（C3S），引发“横向” $SU(3)$-结构。我们证明这个诱导结构属于辛近半平坦（S（nearly）HF）类：$d\omega_\Phi=0$，而$d\Omega_+$在红外“MQGP极限”中被抑制为$\mathcal{O}(e^{-N^{1/3}/\mathcal{O}(1)})$，留下$W_\Phi^{SU(3)}=W_2^-$ 作为唯一的非消失 Chiossi-Salamon 扭转类，并完成 arXiv:1507.02692 、 2004.07259 、 2211.13186 中发起的 MQGP 对偶的 $G$ 结构分类。作为物理应用，通过 $G_2$/S(nearly)HF 扭转数据组织的 $\mathcal{M}_7$ 上 $G_2$ 结构正三型微分的十一维霍奇对偶 Kaluza--Klein 约简，产生一个径向“磁场”$\mathcal{B}_{\rm KK}(r)$，其平方范数精确地分解为外部和内部因素。

$\mathcal{B}_{\rm KK}(r)$ 满足地平线处有规则奇点的贝塞尔型常微分方程；归一性和红外正则性选择$J_2$，上述内部因素的和谐性从大$N$抑制中恢复。 $\mathcal{B}_{\rm KK}$ 通过非线性幂律与 ~IIA 型 $D6$ 膜的磁场相关，为有限温度弦理论中产生弱磁场提供了自上而下的全息机制。

title: Gravitational Compton Amplitude to All Orders in Perturbation Theory
abstract: We show how amplitudes from the scattering of gravitational waves off compact objects in worldline effective field theory can be efficiently computed to arbitrary order in Newton's constant $G$. Our approach solves an effective wave equation for the partial-wave amplitude in which Wilson coefficients (tidal Love numbers) enter through boundary conditions at short distances. We then perform the sum over partial waves to obtain the momentum-space Compton amplitude in terms of elliptic polylogarithms. We reproduce recent results through $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ and obtain new predictions up to $\mathcal{O}(G^7)$, with Love numbers first contributing at $\mathcal{O}(G^5)$. We find the first ultraviolet divergence in a classical gravitational amplitude at $\mathcal{O}(G^7)$, showing that a pure point-particle description is not consistent in general relativity. Matching to black hole perturbation theory, we show that static Love numbers vanish on-shell and predict subleading non-zero Schwarzschild black hole Love numbers.
summary: 我们展示了如何在世界线有效场理论中将来自致密物体的引力波散射的振幅有效地计算为牛顿常数$G$中的任意阶。我们的方法求解了部分波振幅的有效波动方程，其中威尔逊系数（潮汐洛夫数）通过短距离的边界条件进入。然后，我们对部分波进行求和，以获得椭圆多对数形式的动量空间康普顿振幅。我们通过 $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ 重现最近的结果，并获得高达 $\mathcal{O}(G^7)$ 的新预测，其中 Love 数字首先在 $\mathcal{O}(G^5)$ 上做出贡献。我们在 $\mathcal{O}(G^7)$ 处发现了经典引力振幅中的第一个紫外线发散，这表明纯点粒子描述在广义相对论中是不一致的。与黑洞微扰理论相匹配，我们证明了静态洛夫数在壳上消失，并预测了次领先的非零史瓦西黑洞洛夫数。

title: Vortex-Antivortex Annihilation from BPS Equations
abstract: In this work, we introduce a vortex-impurity model that admits BPS configurations containing both vortices and antivortices and allows vortex-antivortex annihilation to be described within the moduli-space approximation. For a suitable class of impurities, the BPS equations can be mapped through a coordinate transformation onto those of the impurity-free Abelian-Higgs model. In particular, we identify nonlocalized impurities that act as mirrors, generating a vortex-antivortex pair symmetrically placed with respect to the impurity. We derive the corresponding moduli-space metric and show that, within the geodesic approximation, the pair approaches the annihilation configuration asymptotically. We further extend the construction to chains and two-dimensional arrays of alternating vortices and antivortices. Finally, we introduce radial bump impurities that produce stretched and compressed vortices with nontrivial internal magnetic structures.
