title: Proof of the AGT Conjecture at Generic $β$
abstract: We give an all-level proof of the four-point $SU(2)$ AGT correspondence with four fundamental hypermultiplets at generic $\beta=-\epsilon_1/\epsilon_2$, by proving an all-level factorization formula for Selberg averages of generalized Jack polynomials. Taking a coefficientwise Jack limit of the generalized Macdonald Pieri rule, we obtain the required one-box matrix elements in the strict Cauchy dual basis. A rational corner-function identity then evaluates the sum over all parent double partitions, while an explicit total derivative of the Selberg kernel yields a triangular recursion on the Dotsenko-Fateev charge balance hyperplane. The unique solution of this recursion is the generalized Kadell formula previously verified only through finite level. Combining this result with the generalized Cauchy identity identifies each double partition term with the corresponding Nekrasov fixed-point contribution.
summary: 通过证明广义 Jack 多项式的 Selberg 平均值的全级分解公式，给出了在通用 $\beta=-\epsilon_1/\epsilon_2$ 处与四个基本超多重数的四点 $SU(2)$ AGT 对应关系的全级证明。采用广义 Macdonald Pieri 规则的系数 Jack 极限，我们在严格的柯西对偶基中获得了所需的单框矩阵元素。然后，有理角函数恒等式评估所有父双分区的总和，而 Selberg 核的显式全导数在 Dotsenko-Fateev 电荷平衡超平面上产生三角递归。该递归的唯一解是先前仅通过有限级别验证的广义Kadell公式。将此结果与广义柯西恒等式相结合，确定每个双分区项与相应的 Nekrasov 定点贡献。

title: Large Deviations for the Bose--Einstein Condensate of the Ideal Gas in the Canonical Ensemble
abstract: We consider a non-interacting Bose gas governed by a general one-particle Hamiltonian in the canonical ensemble. Our main results are large-deviation estimates for the number of particles in the Bose--Einstein condensate. We show that the left- and right-tail probabilities decay at different exponential rates as the number of particles tends to infinity.
summary: 我们考虑由正则系综中的一般单粒子哈密顿量控制的非相互作用玻色气体。我们的主要结果是对玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚中粒子数量的大偏差估计。我们证明，随着粒子数量趋于无穷大，左尾和右尾概率以不同的指数速率衰减。

title: A closure criterion for electromagnetic curves on the sphere in a uniform ambient field
abstract: We consider the motion of a charged test particle confined to the round unit sphere in a uniform ambient magnetic field. We use an extension of Noether's theorem for systems with magnetic forces to reduce the problem to a quadrature. The rotation number of a trajectory, the azimuth it gains over one oscillation in latitude, is a complete elliptic integral of the third kind in Legendre form. A trajectory closes if and only if that advance is a rational multiple of a full turn. The criterion holds on every level set of the two first integrals. Then, we differentiate the rotation number with respect to the half-cyclotron frequency and sign that derivative on each of the two branches into which a level set divides. The rotation number sees the charge, the mass, the field and the speed through a single dimensionless ratio, that of the half-cyclotron frequency to the speed. A closed trajectory therefore fixes a value of that ratio. We say how many values carry a given rational winding. The poles are attainable on a single level set, where the motion reduces to a pendulum. The field has no flux through the sphere, so it is globally exact. We compute the Mañé strict critical value of the resulting exact magnetic flow. Above that value the closed trajectories are closed Reeb orbits of an explicit contact form.
summary:
我们考虑在均匀环境磁场中限制在圆形单位球内的带电测试粒子的运动。我们对具有磁力的系统使用诺特定理的扩展，将问题简化为求积问题。轨迹的旋转数，即它在纬度上一次振荡所获得的方位角，是勒让德形式的第三类完全椭圆积分。当且仅当该前进是整圈的有理倍数时，轨迹才会闭合。该准则适用于前两个积分的每个水平集。然后，我们对旋转数相对于半回旋加速器频率求微分，并在水平集划分的两个分支上对导数进行符号标记。转数通过一个无量纲比率（半回旋加速器频率与速度的比率）来看待电荷、质量、场和速度。因此，闭合轨迹固定了该比率的值。我们说有多少个值带有给定的有理绕组。这些极点可以在单个水平装置上到达，其中运动减少为钟摆。该场没有穿过球体的通量，因此它是全局精确的。

我们计算所得精确磁流的 Mañé 严格临界值。高于该值时，闭合轨迹是显式接触形式的闭合 Reeb 轨道。

title: Quantum cellular automata and invertible phases of matter
abstract: We introduce and study (fermionic and bosonic) invertible quasi-local algebras over uniformly locally finite metric spaces $X$ with infinite-dimensional local von Neumann algebras. We show that the group of Brauer equivalence classes of such algebras is isomorphic to both the group of phases of invertible states and the group of stable equivalence classes of quantum cellular automata over $X\times \mathbb{Z}$. Using K-theory of the symmetric monoidal category of invertible quasi-local algebras and bounded spread isomorphisms, we propose a definition of an $\Omega$-spectrum of invertible phases as conjectured by Kitaev. We then show that the $c=\frac{1}{2}$ chiral Majorana fermion net and the $(E_{8})_{1}$ conformal net provide Brauer non-trivial invertible quasi-local algebras, thus providing explicit constructions of non-trivial invertible states and quantum cellular automata on $\mathbb{Z}^{2}$. In addition, we show that the time-slice nets of rational diagonal conformal field theories admit lattice degrees of freedom, which implies the discretization of any holomorphic conformal net is invertible.
summary: 我们引入并研究了具有无限维局部冯诺依曼代数的均匀局部有限度量空间 $X$ 上的（费米子和玻色子）可逆准局部代数。我们证明，此类代数的布劳尔等价类群与可逆态的相位群和$X\times \mathbb{Z}$上的量子细胞自动机的稳定等价类群同构。利用可逆准局部代数的对称幺半群范畴的 K 理论和有界扩展同构，我们提出了基塔耶夫猜想的可逆相位 $\Omega$ 谱的定义。然后我们证明$c=\frac{1}{2}$手性马约拉纳费米子网和$(E_{8})_{1}$共形网提供布劳尔非平凡可逆准局部代数，从而在$\mathbb{Z}^{2}$上提供非平凡可逆态和量子细胞自动机的显式构造。此外，我们证明有理对角共形场论的时间切片网络允许晶格自由度，这意味着任何全纯共形网络的离散化都是可逆的。

title: Dynamical classical-field limit of Bosonic Gibbs states: Renormalized Hartree NLS correlations in 2D and 3D
abstract: In this paper we derive the time-dependent correlation functions of the renormalized Hartree NLS equation on the torus $\mathbb T^d$, $d=2,3$, from the corresponding bosonic many-body Gibbs dynamics. In contrast with the 1D problem studied earlier by Fröhlich, Knowles, Schlein and Sohinger, in higher dimensions the scaled quantum particle number is not uniformly bounded and the relevant classical fields require Wick renormalization. Our proof combines convergence of the quantum generators in weighted Hilbert spaces with uniqueness for positive solutions of the limiting Liouville equation that are dominated by the Gibbs measure.
summary: 在本文中，我们从相应的玻色多体吉布斯动力学推导了环面$\mathbb T^d$（$d=2,3$）上重正化 Hartree NLS 方程的时间相关相关函数。与 Fröhlich、Knowles、Schlein 和 Sohinger 早期研究的一维问题相反，在更高维度中，缩放后的量子粒子数不是均匀有界的，相关的经典场需要 Wick 重整化。我们的证明结合了加权希尔伯特空间中量子发生器的收敛性和由吉布斯测度主导的极限刘维尔方程正解的唯一性。

title: The Sharp Spectral Transition for Almost Mathieu Operators via Alternating Resonances
abstract: We prove that for any given frequency resonance exponent and phase resonance exponent, there exist a frequency and a phase exactly realizing these values such that the Almost Mathieu operator exhibits Anderson localization for $\ln|\lambda|>\max\{\beta(\alpha),\delta(\alpha,\theta)\}$. This resolves the conjecture in \cite{MR4686650}.
summary: 我们证明，对于任何给定的频率共振指数和相位共振指数，存在精确实现这些值的频率和相位，使得Almost Mathieu算子表现出$\ln|\lambda|>\max\{\beta(\alpha),\delta(\alpha,\theta)\}$的安德森定域性。这解决了\cite{MR4686650}中的猜想。

title: Coupled stochastic variational principles for multiscale surface gravity waves -- Part I: theoretical framework
abstract: This paper develops a comprehensive stochastic variational framework for surface gravity waves. Starting from Luke's variational principle for irrotational, incompressible free-surface flow, we introduce a decomposition of the velocity potential into a large-scale deterministic component and a regularized stochastic noise term representing unresolved scales. A path-wise variational principle yields the stochastic counterparts of the Laplace, Bernoulli, and kinematic boundary conditions. To close the system, a second variational principle in expectation is formulated, providing evolution equations for the noise correlation functions. The resulting coupled system preserves the Hamiltonian structure of the Zakharov--Craig--Sulem formulation. We further analyze explicit solutions via WKB approximation and show that the noise correlation functions satisfy a Hamilton-Jacobi equation with ray-tracing dynamics. This framework provides a rigorous foundation for reduced stochastic models of ocean waves and for the kinetic theory developed in the companion paper.
summary: 本文开发了一个全面的表面重力波随机变分框架。从卢克关于无旋、不可压缩自由表面流的变分原理出发，我们将速度势分解为大尺度确定性分量和代表未解析尺度的正则化随机噪声项。路径变分原理产生拉普拉斯、伯努利和运动学边界条件的随机对应物。为了闭合系统，制定了期望的第二变分原理，提供了噪声相关函数的演化方程。由此产生的耦合系统保留了 Zakharov--Craig--Sulem 公式的哈密顿结构。我们通过 WKB 近似进一步分析显式解，并表明噪声相关函数满足具有射线追踪动力学的 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程。该框架为海浪的简化随机模型和配套论文中开发的动力学理论提供了严格的基础。

title: Quasi-polynomiality and $N$-point functions of single connected leaky completed Hurwitz numbers
abstract: In this paper, we study the structures of single connected $k$-leaky $(r+1)$-completed Hurwitz numbers. We first prove that, for fixed genus, after extracting an explicit product of Pochhammer type factors, the stable connected leaky Hurwitz numbers for partition $\mu$ are polynomials in the quotients $[\mu_i]$ modulo $k+r$. We then give a closed formula for the generating function of single connected leaky Hurwitz numbers, which can be used to study the genus dependence of leaky Hurwitz numbers.
summary: 在本文中，我们研究了单连通 $k$-泄漏 $(r+1)$-完成 Hurwitz 数的结构。我们首先证明，对于固定亏格，在提取 Pochhammer 类型因子的显式乘积后，分区 $\mu$ 的稳定连通泄漏 Hurwitz 数是商 $[\mu_i]$ 模 $k+r$ 的多项式。然后我们给出了单连通漏Hurwitz数生成函数的闭合公式，该公式可用于研究漏Hurwitz数的属相关性。

title: Multiscale Loop Vertex Expansion for Cumulants, the $ϕ^4_2$ Model
abstract: We consider the $\phi^4_2$ model. It has been called the simplest non- trivial super-renormalisable model. The method we use is the multiscale loop vertex expansion, an improvement of constructive field theory. We prove analyticity and Borel summability of the cumulants up to a finite order.
summary: 我们考虑 $\phi^4_2$ 模型。它被称为最简单的非平凡超可重整化模型。我们使用的方法是多尺度循环顶点扩展，是构造场论的改进。我们证明了有限阶累积量的解析性和 Borel 可求和性。

title: 2-Morita Theory of $E_2$-Algebras and Module Categories
abstract: Building on our previous work on 2-Morita equivalence for $E_2$-algebras using topological pictures, we develop a systematic framework for Morita equivalence of topological orders in different dimensions in terms of $n$-Morita categories $\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})$. In this framework, various notions of $n$-Morita equivalence are unified as equivalences of objects in $\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})$. We also compare the constructions of higher Morita categories due to Haugseng and to Gwilliam--Scheimbauer. For $n=1,2$, we prove that the functor $\mathrm{Mod}_n:\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})\to \mathrm{Mrt}_{E_{n-1}}(\mathrm{LMod}^{\mathrm{rep}}(\mathcal{C}))$ is an equivalence, relating the algebraic description of higher Morita theory to its realization in terms of module categories. In this formulation, the notion of a bi-bimodule arises naturally and provides a common framework for local and confined modules. Its explicit orientation data, together with the corresponding fusion rules, clarifies the relations among defects arising from condensation in topological orders.
summary: 基于我们之前使用拓扑图对 $E_2$-代数的 2-Morita 等价所做的工作，我们开发了一个系统框架，用于根据 $n$-Morita 类别 $\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})$ 不同维度拓扑序的 Morita 等价。在此框架中，$n$-Morita 等价的各种概念被统一为 $\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})$ 中对象的等价。我们还比较了 Haugseng 和 Gwilliam-Schheimbauer 的更高 Morita 类别的构造。对于 $n=1,2$，我们证明函子 $\mathrm{Mod}_n:\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})\to \mathrm{Mrt}_{E_{n-1}}(\mathrm{LMod}^{\mathrm{rep}}(\mathcal{C}))$ 是等价的，与更高 Morita 的代数描述相关理论到模块类别的实现。在这个公式中，双双模块的概念自然出现，并为局部和受限模块提供了一个通用框架。其明确的方向数据以及相应的融合规则阐明了拓扑顺序凝聚产生的缺陷之间的关系。

title: Least Variable Quantum Counting Processes
abstract: Counting processes provide a fundamental description of stochastic events ranging from photon detection to clock ticks. A central question is how accurately such events can be timed when only finite memory resources are available. Here, we investigate this problem within a general framework of finite-dimensional classical and quantum counting processes. We derive a rigorous finite-memory variance bound obeyed by every classical $d$-state counting process, which is tight and saturated by a discrete Erlang-type ladder process. Through numerical optimization, we identify quantum counting processes that violate this classical bound, achieving smaller first-tick fluctuations than any classical process with the same memory size and mean tick time. For the qubit case, we further derive an analytical large-mean bound within a single-Kraus no-tick family, showing that the quantum advantage persists asymptotically within this class. The optimized quantum processes exhibit coherent conditioned dynamics and approach a continuous-time quantum-jump description as the mean increases. Our results establish a finite-memory quantum advantage in temporal precision and connect discrete-time counting processes with continuous-time quantum timekeeping.
summary:
计数过程提供了从光子检测到时钟滴答的随机事件的基本描述。一个核心问题是，当只有有限的内存资源可用时，如何准确地对此类事件进行计时。在这里，我们在有限维经典和量子计数过程的一般框架内研究这个问题。我们推导了每个经典 $d$ 状态计数过程所遵循的严格的有限内存方差界限，该界限由离散的 Erlang 型梯形过程紧密且饱和。通过数值优化，我们确定了违反此经典界限的量子计数过程，与具有相同内存大小和平均滴答时间的任何经典过程相比，实现了更小的首次滴答波动。对于量子位情况，我们进一步推导了单 Kraus no-tick 系列中的分析大均值界，表明量子优势在此类中渐近地持续存在。优化的量子过程表现出相干条件动力学，并随着平均值的增加而接近连续时间量子跳跃描述。

我们的结果确立了有限内存量子在时间精度方面的优势，并将离散时间计数过程与连续时间量子计时联系起来。

title: Fast GHZ encoding with $1-o(1)$ fidelity
abstract: We prove that $(1-o(1))$-fidelity $N$-qubit Greenberger--Horne--Zeilinger (GHZ) encoding can be performed in time $O(\log N/N)$ using all-to-all 2-local Hamiltonians with bounded 2-qubit interaction terms. This saturates the theoretical lower bound $\Omega(\log N/N)$, and by rescaling, also saturates the lower bound on signaling time for Hamiltonians with power-law interaction strengths $1/r^\gamma$, $\gamma<d$ in dimension $d$. The protocol uses spin-squeezing dynamics combined with quantum signal processing.
summary: 我们证明 $(1-o(1))$-保真度 $N$-qubit Greenberger--Horne--Zeilinger (GHZ) 编码可以使用具有有界 2-qubit 交互项的所有 2-局部哈密顿量在 $O(\log N/N)$ 时间内执行。这使理论下限 $\Omega(\log N/N)$ 饱和，并且通过重新缩放，也使具有幂律相互作用强度 $1/r^\gamma$、$\gamma<d$ 在维度 $d$ 中的哈密顿量的信号时间下限饱和。该协议使用自旋挤压动力学与量子信号处理相结合。

title: Lieb-Schultz-Mattis Constraints for Quantum Channels: A Spacetime-Duality View
abstract: Quantum anomalies strongly constrain the possible behavior of many-body systems. A prime example is the Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM) theorem, which relates UV symmetry and filling constraints to IR features of the energy spectrum and ground-state structure. Here, we ask how LSM constraints shape dynamical signatures and temporal correlations in open quantum systems. Using a spacetime duality, we show that the Liouvillian of a $d$-dimensional repeated quantum channel with a mixed anomaly between strong $S$ and weak $G$ symmetry can be mapped to a $(d{+}1)$-dimensional mixed-state symmetry-protected topological (mSPT) phase. Under this correspondence, the initial and steady states of the channel are identified with boundary states of the higher-dimensional mSPT in the presence of bulk projection. We further introduce the twisted Renyi-$N$ correlator (TRNC) as a probe of temporal correlations in the channel and demonstrate that it is dual to the mSPT strange correlator, providing a direct bulk-boundary route to diagnose long-range temporal order implied by the LSM anomaly. Finally, we identify the \textit{Liouvillian singular spectrum}, rather than the Liouvillian spectrum itself, as a more fundamental diagnostic of quantum anomalies, and show that it is dual to the operator entanglement spectrum of the mSPT.
summary:
量子异常强烈限制了多体系统可能的行为。一个典型的例子是 Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM) 定理，它将 UV 对称性和填充约束与能谱和基态结构的 IR 特征联系起来。在这里，我们询问 LSM 约束如何塑造开放量子系统中的动态特征和时间相关性。利用时空对偶性，我们证明了具有强$S$和弱$G$对称性之间混合异常的$d$维重复量子通道的刘维尔可以映射到$(d{+}1)$维混合态对称保护拓扑（mSPT）相。在这种对应关系下，在存在体投影的情况下，通道的初始状态和稳态通过高维 mSPT 的边界状态来识别。我们进一步引入扭曲的 Renyi-$N$ 相关器（TRNC）作为通道中时间相关性的探针，并证明它与 mSPT 奇怪相关器是对偶的，为诊断 LSM 异常所暗示的长程时间顺序提供了直接的体边界路径。

最后，我们将 \textit{刘维尔奇异谱}（而不是刘维尔谱本身）确定为量子异常的更基本诊断，并表明它与 mSPT 的算子纠缠谱是对偶的。

title: Bosonic Encodings for Hermite-Galerkin Discretizations of High-Dimensional PDEs and Bayesian Inverse Problems
abstract: The Koopman-von Neumann framework has been proposed to design quantum algorithms for non-linear dynamics. It maps a non-linear ordinary differential equation to a linear partial differential equation (PDE) governing a probability amplitude. Previous works represents this amplitude in the Hermite-function basis, equivalently as a bosonic state, and truncates the total Hermite degree to obtain a representation over $\Theta(m\log N)$ qubits, where $N$ is the number of variables and $m$ the truncation order. We extend this approach to a broader class of linear PDEs whose differential operators have a structured polynomial form. We prove convergence of the truncation for both time-dependent dynamics and gapped ground-state problems under explicit regularity and stability assumptions. We then introduce a qubit encoding that supports efficient block encodings of the truncated operators. Finally, we apply the framework to Bayesian inverse problems with Gaussian priors and observation noise, reducing posterior-state preparation to the preparation of a structured Hamiltonian's ground state.
summary: 库普曼-冯·诺依曼框架已被提出来设计非线性动力学的量子算法。它将非线性常微分方程映射到控制概率幅值的线性偏微分方程 (PDE)。以前的工作在 Hermite 函数基础上表示这个幅度，相当于玻色子态，并截断总 Hermite 度以获得 $\Theta(m\log N)$ 量子位的表示，其中 $N$ 是变量的数量，$m$ 是截断阶数。我们将这种方法扩展到更广泛的线性偏微分方程，其微分算子具有结构化多项式形式。我们证明了在明确的规律性和稳定性假设下，瞬态动力学和带隙基态问题的截断收敛性。然后，我们引入一种支持截断运算符的高效块编码的量子位编码。最后，我们将该框架应用于具有高斯先验和观测噪声的贝叶斯反问题，将后验状态准备减少为结构化哈密顿量基态的准备。

title: Fault-tolerant quantum computation cannot be achieved with constant spacetime overhead
abstract: The threshold theorem states that quantum computations can be made reliable below a physical error threshold, at the cost of additional physical qubits and circuit depth. Recent work has reduced these space and time overheads to polylogarithmic or nearly logarithmic scalings, but whether the cumulative spacetime overhead can be constant has remained unclear. Here, we show that even for the simplest task of preserving quantum information in a quantum memory, under an optimistic noise model and allowing general adaptive protocols, there is an unavoidable logarithmic contribution to the cumulative spacetime overhead. This additional cost can nevertheless be shared among many logical qubits, so sufficiently wide computations, including standard implementations of Shor's algorithm, may still achieve constant relative overhead. We further give a positive-rate CSS code construction that attains the memory bound, identify sufficient conditions under which the same scaling extends from quantum memory to fault-tolerant circuit implementations, and derive circuit-size bounds for subsystem spacetime codes. Our work establishes fundamental limits on the resources required for quantum fault tolerance.
summary:
阈值定理指出，量子计算可以在物理错误阈值以下变得可靠，但代价是额外的物理量子位和电路深度。最近的工作已将这些空间和时间开销减少到多对数或接近对数的尺度，但累积的时空开销是否可以恒定仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明，即使对于在量子存储器中保存量子信息的最简单的任务，在乐观噪声模型下并允许通用自适应协议，对累积时空开销也存在不可避免的对数贡献。然而，这种额外的成本可以在许多逻辑量子位之间共享，因此足够宽的计算，包括 Shor 算法的标准实现，仍然可以实现恒定的相对开销。我们进一步给出了达到内存界限的正率 CSS 代码构造，确定了相同缩放从量子内存扩展到容错电路实现的充分条件，并推导出子系统时空代码的电路大小界限。

我们的工作对量子容错所需的资源建立了基本限制。

title: Quantizing the guiding center: do quantization and coarse graining commute?
abstract: We develop a nonperturbative, group-theoretic quantization of the effective guiding center theory of a charged particle drifting in a magnetic field in two spatial dimensions, and compare the resulting quantum theory with a corresponding coarse graining of the underlying microscopic theory. In the classical effective theory, the small gyro motion is not resolved, while the motion of the center of the gyro orbit remains observable. The reduced phase space is the physical space itself, so quantization leads to noncommuting spatial coordinates, and the effective theory loses access to the metric structure of physical space, retaining only its area structure. By formulating a prescription to match between the microscopic and effective quantum theories, we find that the predictions of the quantized effective theory are generally consistent with those of the microscopic theory. However, for closed isomagnetic contours the effective theory predicts a quantization of ``radius'', a spatial discreteness absent from the microscopic theory. This illustrates that quantization of an effective theory may yield spurious nonperturbative predictions, even if that quantum theory shows no internal signs of breakdown.
summary:
我们开发了在两个空间维度的磁场中漂移的带电粒子的有效引导中心理论的非微扰群论量子化，并将所得的量子理论与基础微观理论的相应粗粒度进行了比较。在经典有效理论中，小陀螺运动没有被解析，而陀螺轨道中心的运动仍然是可观测的。简化的相空间是物理空间本身，因此量化导致不可交换的空间坐标，而有效的理论无法访问物理空间的度量结构，仅保留其区域结构。通过制定微观量子理论与有效量子理论的匹配处方，我们发现量子有效理论的预测与微观理论的预测总体一致。然而，对于闭合等磁轮廓，有效理论预测了“半径”的量化，这是微观理论中不存在的空间离散性。

这说明有效理论的量子化可能会产生虚假的非微扰预测，即使该量子理论没有显示出崩溃的内部迹象。

title: Enhancing the phase sensitivity of a Mach-Zehnder interferometer beyond the Heisenberg limit through dynamic squeezing
abstract: We propose a method to enhance the phase sensitivity of a Mach-Zehnder interferometer, independent of its input states. This is achieved by applying squeezing sequences to one arm of the interferometer. By alternating between squeezing along orthogonal quadratures, we demonstrate that the phase sensitivity of a Mach-Zehnder interferometer can be generically enhanced. Since this enhancement is independent of the input states, the proposed dynamic squeezing method allows for further improvement in phase sensitivity when combined with non-classical input states. We compare the dynamic squeezing approach with existing quantum sensing protocols and show that super-Heisenberg scaling can be achieved. Finally, we demonstrate that the scheme is robust against moderate photon loss.
summary: 我们提出了一种增强马赫曾德尔干涉仪相位灵敏度的方法，与其输入状态无关。这是通过对干涉仪的一个臂应用挤压序列来实现的。通过沿正交正交的交替挤压，我们证明马赫-曾德干涉仪的相位灵敏度可以普遍增强。由于这种增强与输入状态无关，因此所提出的动态压缩方法与非经典输入状态结合时可以进一步提高相位灵敏度。我们将动态压缩方法与现有的量子传感协议进行比较，并表明可以实现超海森堡缩放。最后，我们证明该方案对于中等程度的光子损失具有鲁棒性。

title: Misunderstanding Convivial Solipsism: the Necessity of a Perspectival Logic
abstract: Convivial Solipsism is easily misunderstood. Because it denies the absoluteness of observed events while preserving the universality of quantum mechanics, it invites objections that are often formulated in a classical, non-perspectival language. Such objections appear powerful only because they smuggle back into the discussion the very assumptions that Convivial Solipsism rejects. This article reconstructs a family of misunderstandings that arise in discussions of Convivial Solipsism, especially in connection with Wigner's friend and extended Wigner's friend scenarios. The aim is not merely defensive. The objections are useful because they identify the conceptual discipline required by any interpretation that takes non-absolute facts seriously. The central claim is that observational facts must be indexed to perspectives. A statement such as "the friend saw outcome A" is not a complete factual statement within Convivial Solipsism. It must be reformulated as "from the friend's perspective, the friend saw outcome A" or "from Wigner's perspective, the friend reported outcome B." The mistake consists in removing these indices and then treating the resulting expressions as if they belonged to a single global factual domain. This leads to apparent contradictions and to false dilemmas concerning consciousness, communication, other minds, and intersubjectivity. When that is taken into account, it appears that Convivial Solipsism is not a retreat into psychological solipsism, but a discipline of perspectival discourse. It is also shown that perspectival logic stands to classical logic as the quantum calculus of probability stands to Kolmogorovian probability theory.
summary:
欢乐唯我论很容易被误解。因为它否认观察到的事件的绝对性，同时保留了量子力学的普遍性，所以它招致了通常用经典的、非透视语言表达的反对意见。这些反对意见之所以显得有力，只是因为它们将欢乐唯我论所拒绝的假设带回到了讨论中。本文重建了在欢乐唯我论讨论中出现的一系列误解，特别是与维格纳的朋友和扩展维格纳的朋友场景有关的误解。其目的不仅仅是防御性的。这些反对意见是有用的，因为它们确定了任何认真对待非绝对事实的解释所需的概念纪律。核心主张是观察事实必须与观点建立索引。诸如“朋友看到了结果 A”之类的陈述并不是欢乐唯我论中完整的事实陈述。

它必须重新表述为“从朋友的角度来看，朋友看到了结果 A”或“从维格纳的角度来看，朋友报告了结果 B”。错误在于删除这些索引，然后将结果表达式视为属于单个全局事实域。这导致了关于意识、交流、其他思想和主体间性的明显矛盾和虚假困境。考虑到这一点，欢乐唯我论似乎并不是退回到心理唯我论，而是一种透视话语的学科。它还表明，透视逻辑代表经典逻辑，就像量子概率演算代表柯尔莫哥洛夫概率论一样。

title: Detuning-robust Rydberg entangling gates from echoed pulses
abstract: Rydberg-based two-qubit gate fidelities in neutral atom arrays are limited chiefly by laser intensity inhomogeneity and by detuning errors from frequency miscalibration, background-field drift, intermediate state light shift and Doppler shifts. Quantum optimal control can suppress the former, but no pulse can render a controlled-Z gate first-order insensitive to detuning. Here we show that this obstruction can be circumvented by designing Rydberg gate pulses with every leading-order detuning error relegated to single-qubit Z-rotations, which an echoed sequence removes. The resulting maximally-entangling ZZ gate has no leading-order response to arbitrary detunings on either atom, maintaining an infidelity below $10^{-3}$ much wider range of single-atom detunings than previous gate designs. We further show that a large fraction of residual error is dominated by population outside the computational subspace, which can be converted into heralded erasures. Our results significantly reduce the requirements on laser frequency stability and intensity homogeneity, field calibration and atomic temperature toward practical fault-tolerant quantum computing with neutral atoms.
summary: 中性原子阵列中基于里德堡的双量子位门保真度主要受到激光强度不均匀性以及频率校准错误、背景场漂移、中间态光移和多普勒频移造成的失谐误差的限制。量子最优控制可以抑制前者，但没有脉冲可以使受控 Z 门一阶对失谐不敏感。在这里，我们表明，可以通过设计里德伯门脉冲来规避这种障碍，将每个前导失谐误差降级为单量子位 Z 旋转，回波序列将其消除。由此产生的最大纠缠 ZZ 门对任一原子上的任意失谐都没有前导响应，将不保真度保持在 10^{-3}$ 以下，单原子失谐范围比以前的门设计宽得多。我们进一步表明，残差误差的很大一部分是由计算子空间之外的总体决定的，这可以转换为预示的擦除。我们的结果显着降低了对激光频率稳定性和强度均匀性、场校准和原子温度的要求，以实现中性原子的实用容错量子计算。

title: Demystifying Relativistic Quantum Collapse
abstract: Non-relativistic objective collapse theories have been remarkably successful in addressing the conceptual problems of standard quantum mechanics. Despite substantial efforts, the project of extending them to the relativistic domain remains burdened by significant conceptual objections and technical challenges, often taken to cast doubt on the viability of the program as a whole. On the conceptual side, relativistic collapse theories have been claimed to face challenges involving tension between instantaneous collapse and relativity, frame-dependence of property values and probabilities, the possibility of superluminal signaling and the failure of narratability. On the technical side, persistent infinities, difficulties in constructing fully covariant frameworks and the apparent need for non-standard fields have hindered the development of workable models. In this paper, we offer a systematic rebuttal of the conceptual objections and provide a structured account of the remaining technical challenges. We conclude that relativistic collapse theories do provide a promising route toward a fully relativistic quantum framework that overcomes the conceptual limitations of standard quantum theory.
summary:
非相对论客观塌陷理论在解决标准量子力学的概念问题方面取得了巨大成功。尽管付出了巨大的努力，将它们扩展到相对论领域的项目仍然受到重大概念上的反对和技术挑战的困扰，这常常让人对整个项目的可行性产生怀疑。在概念方面，相对论崩溃理论被认为面临着挑战，包括瞬时崩溃和相对论之间的紧张关系、属性值和概率的框架依赖性、超光速信号的可能性以及可叙述性的失败。在技​​术方面，持续的无穷大、构建完全协变框架的困难以及对非标准字段的明显需求阻碍了可行模型的开发。在本文中，我们对概念性反对意见进行了系统的反驳，并对剩余的技术挑战进行了结构化的说明。

我们的结论是，相对论坍缩理论确实为完全相对论量子框架提供了一条有希望的途径，克服了标准量子理论的概念限制。

title: Strong Coupling of the Mo Mo Stretching Mode to a Locally Confined Stokes Raman Field in Mo2 Molecular Resonators
abstract: Confining optical fields to molecular dimensions is a central objective in nanophotonics and molecular quantum optics. Here, we report strong coupling of the Mo Mo stretching vibration to a locally confined Raman scattering field in quadruply bonded dimolybdenum complexes. Under ambient, cavity-free conditions, the dimolybdenum formamidinate complexes Mo2(DAniF)4 and Mo2(DTolF)4 exhibit Rabi-type splitting, Mollow-type sidebands, and higher-order Raman features centered near the Mo Mo stretching frequency of 400 cm-1, indicating formation of dressed vibration field states. The sideband displacements from the resonance follow the photon-number-dependent relation {\Omega}n={\Omega}{\nu}n, consistent with Jaynes Cummings-type coupling, while strongly displaced Raman features are assigned to leapfrog transitions within the same dressed-state ladder. In contrast, the less polarizable Mo2(O2CCH3)4 complex exhibits essentially a single Mo Mo stretching band. Reanalysis of reported resonance Raman spectra of an alkynyl Mo2 complex further supports this coupling framework. These results suggest that the Mo2 unit simultaneously serves as the Raman active oscillator and the molecular resonator that supports, confines, and enhances the locally generated scattering field, providing spectroscopic evidence for vibration field coupling and optical-field confinement within a chemically defined metal metal bond.
summary:
将光场限制在分子维度是纳米光子学和分子量子光学的核心目标。在这里，我们报告了四键二钼配合物中 Mo Mo 伸缩振动与局部限制拉曼散射场的强耦合。在环境、无空腔条件下，甲脒二钼配合物 Mo2(DAniF)4 和 Mo2(DTolF)4 表现出 Rabi 型分裂、Mollow 型边带和以 400 cm-1 Mo Mo 伸缩频率为中心的高阶拉曼特征，表明形成了修饰的振动场态。共振的边带位移遵循光子数相关关系 {\Omega}n={\Omega}{\nu}n，与 Jaynes Cummings 型耦合一致，而强位移拉曼特征被分配给同一修饰状态梯内的蛙跳跃迁。相反，极化程度较低的 Mo2(O2CCH3)4 络合物基本上表现出单一的 Mo Mo 伸缩带。对报道的炔基 Mo2 配合物的共振拉曼光谱的重新分析进一步支持了这种耦合框架。

这些结果表明，Mo2 单元同时充当拉曼有源振荡器和分子谐振器，支持、限制和增强局部生成的散射场，为化学定义的金属金属键内的振动场耦合和光场限制提供光谱证据。

title: Auditing Structured Randomness for Quantum Error Correction under a Bounded Cloud Fault Model
abstract: Cloud quantum processors compile submitted quantum error correction circuits and may colocate them with untrusted workloads. A fixed public encoder gives a fault-injection adversary a reusable target. Per-run reseeding changes the physical-to-logical fault map. Exact Haar-random encoders have exponential circuit cost. Efficient random ensembles provide average-moment guarantees and leave worst-case accepted corruption uncharacterized. We define accepted logical disturbance, an acceptance-weighted measure of harmful logical action in accepted results, and derive its exact Haar expectation. We evaluate a polynomial-cost seeded Clifford encoder family using dense linear algebra and gate-level stabilizer simulation against faults chosen before or after the encoder is known. Reseeding reduces mean accepted logical disturbance from 0.150 for faults chosen after learning each encoder to 0.020 for one fault chosen before it is known. The 86.7% reduction results from rejection. The fixed distance-three \([[5,1,3]]\) code corrects every tested weight-one Pauli, while 18.5% of sampled encoders in the selected ensemble satisfy exact quantum error correction. The measured reduction quantifies the integrity gain from reseeding and separates postselected detection from exact correction under explicit fault and attacker-knowledge models.
summary:
云量子处理器编译提交的量子纠错电路，并可能将它们与不受信任的工作负载并置。固定的公共编码器为故障注入对手提供了可重用的目标。每次运行重新播种会更改物理到逻辑的故障图。精确的哈尔随机编码器具有指数电路成本。高效的随机集成提供了平均时刻的保证，并且使最坏情况下接受的腐败不被表征。我们定义了接受的逻辑扰动，即接受结果中有害逻辑行为的接受加权度量，并得出其精确的哈尔期望。我们使用密集线性代数和门级稳定器仿真来评估多项式成本种子 Clifford 编码器系列，以针对编码器已知之前或之后选择的故障。重新播种将平均可接受的逻辑干扰从学习每个编码器后选择的故障的 0.150 降低到已知之前选择的一个故障的 0.020。 86.7% 的减少是由于拒绝造成的。固定距离三 \([[5,1,3]]\) 代码纠正了每个测试的权重一泡利，而所选集合中 18.5% 的采样编码器满足精确的量子纠错。

测量到的减少量量化了重新播种所带来的完整性增益，并将后选择检测与显式故障和攻击者知识模型下的精确校正分开。

title: Quantum estimation theory with quantum noise control
abstract: Quantum estimation theory serves as one of fundamental backbones of quantum Shannon information theory and was mathematically systematized by pioneers of quantum information science. Although its applied research saw limited progress for a long period, the 21st century has witnessed active discussions and numerous fruitful proposals regarding its applications. Notably, the contributions of Monras and Paris represent one of the most remarkable achievements addressing the realization problem of estimation bounds. This paper aims to demonstrate a practical direction for extending their original ideas. Next-generation quantum information mechanisms urgently demand guarantees of quantum advantage unattainable by classical theory, alongside strict real-time processing without delays. By leveraging the concept of generalized heterodyne detection proposed nearly half a century ago, we demonstrate that a scheme based on their results can effectively meet the stringent requirements of near-future information technologies.
summary: 量子估计理论是量子香农信息论的基本支柱之一，并由量子信息科学的先驱在数学上系统化。尽管其应用研究长期以来进展有限，但进入21世纪后，有关其应用的讨论十分活跃，并提出了许多富有成效的建议。值得注意的是，蒙拉斯和巴黎的贡献代表了解决估计界限的实现问题的最引人注目的成就之一。本文旨在展示扩展其原始想法的实用方向。下一代量子信息机制迫切需要保证经典理论无法实现的量子优势，以及严格的无延迟实时处理。通过利用近半个世纪前提出的广义外差检测的概念，我们证明了基于其结果的方案可以有效地满足近期信息技术的严格要求。

title: Quantum Rare-Event Estimation for Ising Graphical Models with Belief-Propagation State Preparation
abstract: Quantum amplitude estimation can reduce the sampling cost of rare-event probability estimation, but applying it to correlated Ising graphical models is limited by the difficulty of preparing the target distribution and building a practical event oracle. This work explores two approximate strategies for mitigating these challenges. We introduce a sample-free state-preparation method combining loopy belief propagation with the Chow--Liu algorithm. The resulting tree approximation is compiled into a quantum circuit with linear gate count and depth, and its accuracy is evaluated across graph families spanning different topologies, coupling strengths, and coupling signs. We also construct a structural oracle that evaluates threshold rules with reversible Boolean gates. Using a twenty-node supply-chain disruption model as a case study, we compare maximum likelihood amplitude estimation against four classical Monte Carlo baselines. Under the fixed-depth schedule used throughout this work, the quantum estimator has the same asymptotic error scaling as the classical methods but achieves lower estimation error by a constant factor. This reduction narrows when amplitude-encoding queries replace raw shots as the resource metric. We separate statistical error from the deterministic errors caused by approximate state preparation and oracle construction, and identify the requirements for achieving an improvement beyond a constant factor.
summary:
量子幅度估计可以降低罕见事件概率估计的采样成本，但将其应用于相关伊辛图模型受到准备目标分布和构建实用事件预言机的难度的限制。这项工作探讨了缓解这些挑战的两种近似策略。我们引入了一种将循环置信传播与 Chow--Liu 算法相结合的无样本状态准备方法。所得的树近似被编译成具有线性门数和深度的量子电路，并在跨越不同拓扑、​​耦合强度和耦合符号的图族中评估其准确性。我们还构建了一个结构预言机，用可逆布尔门评估阈值规则。使用二十节点供应链中断模型作为案例研究，我们将最大似然幅度估计与四个经典蒙特卡罗基线进行比较。在整个工作中使用的固定深度计划下，量子估计器具有与经典方法相同的渐近误差缩放，但通过常数因子实现较低的估计误差。

当幅度编码查询取代原始镜头作为资源指标时，这种减少会缩小。我们将统计误差与近似状态准备和预言构建引起的确定性误差分开，并确定实现超出常数因子的改进的要求。

title: Energy Ordering from Nonlinear Quantum Dissipation
abstract: Energy-ordered occupation is deeply embedded in quantum physics, from the Aufbau principle governing the filling of electronic states in atoms and molecules to the emergence of low-energy configurations in quantum many-body systems. However, the dynamical mechanism by which a generic quantum state develops such an energy hierarchy remains a fundamental question. Here we show that such an energy hierarchy can emerge dynamically from nonlinear quantum dissipation. Rather than being imposed as a principle or generated through coupling to a thermal reservoir, an Aufbau-like ordering of energy levels emerges intrinsically under quantum Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert dynamics from a generic initial mixed state. This convergence is a nontrivial consequence of Lyapunov monotonicity and instability of disordered population configurations. The resulting dynamics establish an intrinsic nonlinear mechanism for organizing density-matrix populations and provides a route toward selective preparation of low-energy subspaces. Numerical simulations confirm analytical predictions and illustrate convergence toward low-energy sectors.
summary: 能量有序占据深深植根于量子物理学中，从控制原子和分子中电子态填充的 Aufbau 原理到量子多体系统中低能构型的出现。然而，通用量子态发展这种能量层次的动力学机制仍然是一个基本问题。在这里，我们证明这种能量层次可以从非线性量子耗散中动态出现。类似 Aufbau 的能级排序不是作为一个原理强加的，也不是通过与热储层耦合生成的，而是在量子朗道-利夫希茨-吉尔伯特动力学下从一般的初始混合态本质上出现的。这种收敛是李雅普诺夫单调性和无序总体配置的不稳定性的重要结果。由此产生的动力学建立了用于组织密度矩阵群体的内在非线性机制，并提供了选择性制备低能量子空间的途径。数值模拟证实了分析预测，并说明了向低能源行业的融合。

title: Bound-state-mediated remote charging of a quantum battery
abstract: Remote charging of a quantum battery (QB) is hindered by radiative leakage of the excitation into the photonic environment that acts as a mediator for energy transfer. We consider a charger-battery model consisting of two two-level systems (TLSs) that are locally coupled to two sites of a one-dimensional coupled cavity array. When their transition frequency lies outside the propagation band, the system forms atom-photon bound states with localized photonic components, and the overlap of these components lifts the degeneracy of the even- and odd-parity bound states, yielding an energy splitting that drives coherent energy transfer from the charger to the QB. In this way, the band gap suppresses resonant emission and the localized bound states mediate remote charging. From the parity-resolved spectrum, we relate the charging time to the energy splitting and the charged ergotropy to the fraction of TLS population on the bound states. Bound states closer to the band edge extend the interaction range of the TLSs but contain a large photonic fraction and are consequently more susceptible to photon loss.
summary: 量子电池 (QB) 的远程充电受到激发辐射泄漏到充当能量传输中介的光子环境的阻碍。我们考虑由两个两级系统（TLS）组成的充电器电池模型，这两个系统局部耦合到一维耦合腔阵列的两个站点。当它们的跃迁频率位于传播带之外时，系统形成具有局域光子分量的原子-光子束缚态，并且这些分量的重叠提升了偶奇偶校验束缚态的简并性，产生能量分裂，驱动从充电器到QB的相干能量传输。通过这种方式，带隙抑制谐振发射，而局域束缚态介导远程充电。从宇称分辨光谱中，我们将充电时间与能量分裂相关联，并将带电的各向异性与束缚态上 TLS 布居的分数相关联。靠近能带边缘的束缚态扩大了 TLS 的相互作用范围，但包含较大的光子部分，因此更容易受到光子损失的影响。

title: Geometric optimality of entanglement-induced fast qubit reset
abstract: Fast and reliable qubit reset is essential for the efficient operation of quantum processors. Among the proposed strategies, Mpemba-effect-based protocols offer a simple route to accelerated relaxation, but provide limited insight into the optimality of the full reset dynamics. Geometric approaches, by contrast, quantify optimality but do not generally suggest practical acceleration protocols. Here, we bridge these perspectives through a geometric analysis of entanglement-assisted qubit reset. We show that entangling operations can redistribute local coherences across a multi-qubit register, allowing the reduced state of each qubit to follow a geodesic path towards the ground state. Remarkably, this locally optimal behaviour can emerge even when the collective evolution becomes suboptimal in the full state space. We illustrate this interplay for different families of initial multi-qubit states. Our results provide a geometric perspective on Mpemba-inspired reset acceleration and clarify when extending two-qubit protocols to larger registers provides a further advantage in the reset process.
summary: 快速可靠的量子位重置对于量子处理器的高效运行至关重要。在提出的策略中，基于 Mpemba 效应的协议提供了一种加速放松的简单途径，但对完全重置动态的最优性提供的了解有限。相比之下，几何方法量化了最优性，但通常不建议实用的加速协议。在这里，我们通过纠缠辅助量子位重置的几何分析来桥接这些观点。我们证明，纠缠操作可以在多量子位寄存器上重新分配局部相干性，从而允许每个量子位的还原态遵循测地线路径走向基态。值得注意的是，即使集体进化在整个状态空间中变得次优，这种局部最优行为也可能出现。我们说明了初始多量子位状态的不同系列的这种相互作用。我们的结果提供了关于 Mpemba 启发的重置加速的几何视角，并阐明了何时将两个量子位协议扩展到更大的寄存器在重置过程中提供了进一步的优势。

title: Corrections induced by the GUP to the Lamb shift of an accelerated atom interacting with a quantum scalar field
abstract: We investigate the effect of the GUP on the Lamb shift of a two-level atom interacting with a real massless scalar quantum field, within the DDC formalism. For an atom undergoing inertial motion, uniform acceleration, and uniform circular motion, we analyze the separate contributions of vacuum fluctuations and radiation reaction. We first derive the statistical functions of the field along the atom's trajectories for the three types of motion, expressing them as frequency integrals, and then employ them to calculate the vacuum fluctuation and radiation reaction contributions to the radiative level shift. We show that the GUP-modified Lamb shift of the two-level atom arises entirely from vacuum fluctuations and acquires additional corrections proportional to $\beta$. We focus in particular on the acceleration-dependent GUP corrections. For a uniformly accelerated atom, the GUP corrections comprise thermal and nonthermal parts. At low accelerations, the thermal part exhibits nonmonotonic behavior, and is proportional to $a^4$ in the limit $a/\omega_0 \to 0$; the nonthermal part, by contrast, grows nonlinearly and monotonically, exceeding the thermal part by nearly two orders of magnitude at large accelerations. For an atom in uniform circular motion, the GUP corrections are purely nonthermal and also display a nonlinear, monotonic dependence on acceleration, increasing or decreasing steeply according to the sign of $\beta$. For the same $\beta$, the corrections are larger in uniform circular motion than in uniformly accelerated motion, since the former involves terms proportional to both $a^2$ and $a^3$, whereas the latter contains only $a^2$ terms.
summary:
我们研究了 DDC 形式中 GUP 对与真实无质量标量量子场相互作用的两能级原子的兰姆位移的影响。对于经历惯性运动、匀加速运动和匀速圆周运动的原子，我们分析了真空涨落和辐射反应的单独贡献。我们首先推导出三种类型运动沿原子轨迹的场的统计函数，将它们表示为频率积分，然后用它们来计算真空涨落和辐射反应对辐射能级移动的贡献。我们证明了两能级原子的 GUP 修正兰姆位移完全由真空波动引起，并获得与 $\beta$ 成比例的额外校正。我们特别关注与加速度相关的 GUP 修正。对于均匀加速的原子，GUP 校正包括热部分和非热部分。

在低加速度下，热部分表现出非单调行为，并且在极限 $a/\omega_0 \to 0$ 内与 $a^4$ 成正比；相比之下，非热部分非线性且单调地增长，在大加速度下超过热部分近两个数量级。对于匀速圆周运动的原子，GUP 校正纯粹是非热的，并且还显示出对加速度的非线性、单调依赖性，根据 $\beta$ 的符号急剧增加或减少。对于相同的 $\beta$，匀速圆周运动的修正量比匀速加速运动的修正量大，因为前者涉及与 $a^2$ 和 $a^3$ 成比例的项，而后者仅包含 $a^2$ 项。

title: A Superconducting Phase Transition Single-Electron Transistor
abstract: Quantum computers require fast and accurate methods for qubit state detection. Phase-transition sensors exploit the abrupt change between two physical states of a material to achieve enhanced sensitivity and have enabled advanced detectors for quantum technologies, such as superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors. However, this sensing principle has not yet been applied to semiconductor spin qubits. Here, we demonstrate a superconducting phase-transition radio-frequency single-electron transistor (PTSET), a charge sensor for semiconductor spin qubits whose response is enhanced by a superconducting-to-normal phase transition. The transition is engineered by linking the sensor current to a low-critical-current, high-kinetic-inductance inductor integrated into the radio-frequency matching network. We demonstrate improvements in sensitivity of one and two orders of magnitude over conventional rfSETs in the large- and small-signal regimes, respectively. Our results establish phase-transition sensing as a route towards ultrasensitive, integrated charge sensors for semiconductor quantum computing and point to broader applications, including cryogenic photon detection for radio astronomy.
summary:
量子计算机需要快速、准确的量子位状态检测方法。相变传感器利用材料两种物理状态之间的突变来提高灵敏度，并实现了用于量子技术的先进探测器，例如超导纳米线单光子探测器。然而，这种传感原理尚未应用于半导体自旋量子位。在这里，我们展示了一种超导相变射频单电子晶体管（PTSET），这是一种用于半导体自旋量子位的电荷传感器，其响应通过超导到正常相变而增强。该转换是通过将传感器电流链接到集成到射频匹配网络中的低临界电流、高动感电感器来设计的。我们证明了在大信号和小信号范围内，与传统 rfSET 相比，灵敏度分别提高了一个和两个数量级。

我们的研究结果确立了相变传感作为半导体量子计算超灵敏集成电荷传感器的一条途径，并指出了更广泛的应用，包括射电天文学的低温光子探测。

title: Towards Reproducible Evaluation of Distributed Quantum Circuit Partitioning Algorithms
abstract: Distributed Quantum Computing (DQC) addresses the physical scaling limitations of monolithic quantum processors by networking modular Quantum Processing Units (QPUs). Efficient execution of quantum algorithms on DQC architectures requires compiling them across QPUs while minimizing inter-QPU communication bottlenecks, primarily through circuit partitioning. However, current evaluations of state-of-the-art partitioning heuristics focus primarily on the total entanglement cost of the partitions, failing to capture the broader structural and temporal overheads introduced by distributed network constraints. This paper addresses this evaluation gap by applying established monolithic benchmarking metrics to partitioned distributed circuits to quantify the performance impact of network constraints. Using an open-source, automated evaluation pipeline, we systematically assess diverse partitioning algorithms across standardized workloads and quantum network topologies. Our empirical results reveal that partitioning algorithms with comparable entanglement costs can still introduce drastically different physical execution penalties. By exposing these hidden trade-offs, such as severe increases in circuit depth and substantial reductions in gate density, this study demonstrates that comprehensive circuit-level metrics are essential for guiding the future design of DQC compilers.
summary:
分布式量子计算 (DQC) 通过联网模块化量子处理单元 (QPU) 解决单片量子处理器的物理扩展限制。在 DQC 架构上高效执行量子算法需要跨 QPU 进行编译，同时主要通过电路分区来最大限度地减少 QPU 间的通信瓶颈。然而，当前对最先进的分区启发式的评估主要集中在分区的总纠缠成本上，未能捕获分布式网络约束引入的更广泛的结构和时间开销。本文通过将已建立的整体基准测试指标应用于分区分布式电路来量化网络约束的性能影响，从而解决了这一评估差距。使用开源的自动化评估管道，我们系统地评估标准化工作负载和量子网络拓扑中的各种分区算法。我们的实证结果表明，具有可比纠缠成本的分区算法仍然会引入截然不同的物理执行惩罚。

通过揭示这些隐藏的权衡，例如电路深度的大幅增加和门密度的大幅降低，本研究表明，全面的电路级指标对于指导 DQC 编译器的未来设计至关重要。

title: Kramers pseudospin and the quantum number proposed for the many-electron Dirac?Coulomb Hamiltonian
abstract: The square of a sum of single-electron time reversals has been proposed as a conserved quantity with an integer eigenvalue spectrum for the many-electron Dirac-Coulomb Hamiltonian [Phys. Rev. A 94, 052104 (2016)], and its expectation value is in use as a diagnostic of Kramers contamination. This work identifies the operator behind the construction, a component of a pseudospin attached to the chosen Kramers pairs, whose angular-momentum algebra reproduces the reported spectrum and yields the eigenvectors in closed form. The label $k$ entering the proposed quantum number $-k^2$ is twice the magnitude of a pseudospin projection onto an axis fixed by the basis and changes when the Kramers pairs are rephased. The commutation with the Hamiltonian is unfounded, and the proposed quantum number does not stand.
summary: 已提出单电子时间反转之和的平方作为多电子狄拉克-库仑哈密顿量的具有整数特征值谱的守恒量 [Phys. Rev. A 94, 052104 (2016)]，其期望值用于诊断 Kramers 污染。这项工作确定了该结构背后的算子，这是附加到所选克莱默对的赝自旋的一个组成部分，其角动量代数再现了报告的光谱并产生闭合形式的特征向量。输入提议的量子数 $-k^2$ 的标签 $k$ 是由基础固定的轴上赝自旋投影幅度的两倍，并且当克莱默对重新定相时会发生变化。与哈密顿量的交换是没有根据的，并且所提出的量子数不成立。

title: Dynamics and spectra of open quantum systems coupled to anharmonic environments
abstract: In open quantum systems, the environment is typically modelled as a collection of harmonic oscillators, whereas realistic environments often exhibit unique non-Markovian effects due to the anharmonicity of the environment. Here we present a framework for modelling anharmonic environments in open quantum systems numerically exactly, in which, via a matching criterion, we map the anharmonic environment onto an effective harmonic one. This results in an effective spectral density that is a collection of shifted bare spectra arising from the non-equidistant energy gaps of the anharmonic environment, along with a unique zero-frequency term that effectively acts as static disorder on the system. This is due to the non-zero variance of the diagonal of the bath coupling operator. In tandem, we develop a framework for investigating the effects of environments comprising a few damped anharmonic modes where the matching criterion fails to work due to the non-Gaussianity of the environment. For both continuous and discrete damped anharmonic environments, this work investigates their unique influence on the system's dynamics, including enhanced non-Markovianity compared to a harmonic approximation, novel effects in the absorption spectrum, and the potential for anharmonic environments to enhance energy transport.
summary:
在开放量子系统中，环境通常被建模为谐振子的集合，而现实环境通常由于环境的非和谐性而表现出独特的非马尔可夫效应。在这里，我们提出了一种对开放量子系统中的非调和环境进行精确数值建模的框架，其中通过匹配标准，我们将非调和环境映射到有效的调和环境。这产生了有效的谱密度，它是由非谐波环境的非等距能隙产生的偏移裸谱的集合，以及有效地充当系统静态无序的独特零频率项。这是由于浴耦合算子的对角线的非零方差造成的。同时，我们开发了一个框架来研究由一些阻尼非谐模式组成的环境影响，其中由于环境的非高斯性，匹配标准无法发挥作用。

对于连续和离散阻尼非谐环境，这项工作研究了它们对系统动力学的独特影响，包括与谐波近似相比增强的非马尔可夫性、吸收光谱的新颖效应以及非谐环境增强能量传输的潜力。

title: Conditional contraction coefficients and their applications to quantum networks
abstract: Contraction coefficients quantify the loss of distinguishability induced by a channel and provide a strong form of the data-processing inequality. While standard contraction coefficients ignore auxiliary quantum systems, existing extensions based on complete contraction coefficients require the compared states to have identical reference marginals. In this work, we introduce conditional contraction coefficients, a novel family that incorporates arbitrary quantum reference systems by subtracting the distinguishability already present in the reference system. We develop a general framework for contraction coefficients with such quantum side information, including the corresponding strong-data-processing-inequality (SDPI) constants, expansion coefficients, and relative contraction coefficients. For the trace distance, we show that the optimization can be restricted to orthogonal input states. For the quantum relative entropy, we prove that its conditional contraction coefficient is exactly equal to the contraction coefficient of the conditional mutual information, extending the classical correspondence between relative-entropy contraction and mutual-information contraction to the setting with quantum side information. More generally, we identify structural properties of divergences required for these results and discuss extensions beyond the relative entropy. These results establish a unified framework for analyzing information contraction in quantum network settings, where quantum side information and distributed correlations are intrinsic features of the information-processing task. Applications include an extension of the Polyanskiy-Wu bounds on mutual information contraction, new perspectives on mixing times, and fundamental limits on quantum memories.
summary:
收缩系数量化了通道引起的可区分性损失，并提供了数据处理不等式的强有力形式。虽然标准收缩系数忽略辅助量子系统，但基于完全收缩系数的现有扩展要求比较状态具有相同的参考边际。在这项工作中，我们引入了条件收缩系数，这是一个新颖的家族，它通过减去参考系统中已有的可区分性来合并任意量子参考系统。我们利用此类量子辅助信息开发了收缩系数的通用框架，包括相应的强数据处理不等式（SDPI）常数、膨胀系数和相对收缩系数。对于迹线距离，我们表明优化可以限制在正交输入状态。

对于量子相对熵，我们证明其条件收缩系数恰好等于条件互信息的收缩系数，将相对熵收缩和互信息收缩之间的经典对应关系扩展到具有量子辅助信息的设置。更一般地说，我们确定这些结果所需的散度的结构特性，并讨论相对熵之外的扩展。这些结果建立了一个统一的框架，用于分析量子网络设置中的信息收缩，其中量子辅助信息和分布式相关性是信息处理任务的固有特征。应用包括互信息收缩的 Polyanskiy-Wu 界限的扩展、混合时间的新视角以及量子存储器的基本限制。

title: Strong Converse Exponent of Quantum State Merging
abstract: We determine the strong converse exponent for the entanglement cost of quantum state merging, showing that it is characterized by the optimized $\alpha$-$z$ conditional Rényi entropies with $z=\alpha/2\in[1/2,1]$. This contrasts with the sandwiched conditional Rényi entropies that typically govern strong converse exponents in quantum information theory. As a consequence, we derive the strong converse exponent of the partially smoothed conditional min-entropy in purified distance. This exponent is governed by club-sandwiched conditional entropies, whereas global smoothing leads to a sandwiched expression.
summary: 我们确定了量子态合并的纠缠成本的强逆指数，表明它的特征是优化的 $\alpha$-$z$ 条件 Rényi 熵，其中 $z=\alpha/2\in[1/2,1]$。这与量子信息理论中通常控制强逆指数的夹层条件 Rényi 熵形成对比。因此，我们推导出纯化距离中部分平滑条件最小熵的强逆指数。该指数受俱乐部夹心条件熵控制，而全局平滑则导致夹心表达式。

title: The Find Rows and Columns and Decode algorithm for quantum expander codes
abstract: A new adaptation of the Find Erasures and Decode algorithm from classical to quantum expander codes is presented. It runs in linear time and is parallelizable to logarithmic depth. Compared to Small Set Flip and Small Set Find, the new algorithm avoids the overhead of considering the subsets of stabilizer generators, requires less expansion and corrects more errors.
summary: 提出了从经典代码到量子扩展器代码的查找擦除和解码算法的新改编。它以线性时间运行，并且可并行化至对数深度。与小集翻转和小集查找相比，新算法避免了考虑稳定器生成器子集的开销，需要更少的扩展并纠正更多的错误。

title: Optimal cloning of mixed states
abstract: We consider the problem of approximate cloning of quantum states: given $n$ copies of an unknown state $\rho \in \mathbb{C}^{d \times d}$, prepare an $(n+k)$-copy state with high fidelity to $\rho^{\otimes (n+k)}$. Werner's pure state cloner is the optimal channel for the pure state case, and shows that $n = \Theta(kd/\varepsilon)$ copies are necessary and sufficient to clone $k$ additional copies of an unknown pure state to fidelity $1-\varepsilon$. The random purification channel gives a straightforward extension of Werner's cloner to mixed state inputs: given $n$ copies of a mixed state, randomly purify your input, apply Werner's channel in the larger Hilbert space, and then trace out the auxiliary registers. This gives a mixed state cloner using $n = O(krd/\varepsilon)$ copies to clone rank-$r$ states. Can one do any better? We show that the answer is no: one must use $n = \Omega(krd/\varepsilon)$ copies. We prove our lower bound by studying the special case of projector cloning, in which the input state $\rho$ is promised to be of the form $P/r$, where $P$ is a rank-$r$ orthogonal projector. As a further application of our techniques, we consider the closely related problem of approximate transposition of quantum states, where one seeks to convert $\rho^{\otimes n}$ to a $k$-copy state with high fidelity to $(\rho^T)^{\otimes k}$. Here, we again show $n = \Theta(krd/\varepsilon)$ copies are necessary and sufficient for this task.
summary:
我们考虑量子态的近似克隆问题：给定$n$个未知状态$\rho \in \mathbb{C}^{d \times d}$的副本，准备一个与$\rho^{\otimes (n+k)}$高保真度的$(n+k)$复制状态。 Werner 的纯状态克隆器是纯状态情况的最佳通道，并表明 $n = \Theta(kd/\varepsilon)$ 副本对于将未知纯状态的 $k$ 个附加副本克隆到保真度 $1-\varepsilon$ 是必要且充分的。随机净化通道将维尔纳的克隆器直接扩展到混合状态输入：给定混合状态的 $n$ 副本，随机净化你的输入，在更大的希尔伯特空间中应用维尔纳的通道，然后追踪辅助寄存器。这给出了一个混合状态克隆器，使用 $n = O(krd/\varepsilon)$ 副本来克隆排名 $r$ 状态。还能做得更好吗？我们证明答案是否定的：必须使用 $n = \Omega(krd/\varepsilon)$ 副本。我们通过研究投影仪克隆的特殊情况来证明我们的下界，其中输入状态 $\rho$ 被承诺为 $P/r$ 形式，其中 $P$ 是一个等级 $r$ 正交投影仪。

作为我们技术的进一步应用，我们考虑与量子态近似转置密切相关的问题，其中寻求将 $\rho^{\otimes n}$ 转换为 $k$ 复制状态，并与 $(\rho^T)^{\otimes k}$ 保持高保真度。在这里，我们再次证明 $n = \Theta(krd/\varepsilon)$ 副本对于此任务是必要且充分的。

title: The Geometry of Dissipative Complexity: A Levi-Type Decomposition Theorem for Markovian Quantum Dynamics via Lie Wedges and Invariant Cones
abstract: Lie algebras describe how control Hamiltonians combine in closed quantum systems. In open Markovian systems, however, dissipation introduces irreversible directions that the Lie algebra alone does not retain. A dynamical Lie wedge preserves this information as a convex cone of locally admissible generators. The classical Levi decomposition separates a finite-dimensional Lie algebra into semisimple and solvable parts. In this work, we prove a corresponding decomposition and reconstruction theorem for dynamical Lie wedges. The theorem decomposes the wedge into semisimple and solvable data, records how these components are coupled, and provides a converse reconstruction of the wedge. The framework yields four structural types of the generated algebra. We further prove that the total dissipation strength of every admissible generator depends only on its coordinate in the solvable radical. In particular, if the generated Lie algebra is semisimple, every admissible generator is Hamiltonian. Together, these results extend Lie-algebraic structural methods to irreversible Markovian control and clarify how dissipation is encoded in the generator geometry.
summary: 李代数描述了控制哈密顿量如何在封闭量子系统中组合。然而，在开放马尔可夫系统中，耗散引入了仅李代数无法保留的不可逆方向。动态李楔将这些信息保留为局部允许生成器的凸锥体。经典李维分解将有限维李代数分解为半简单和可解的部分。在这项工作中，我们证明了动态李楔的相应分解和重构定理。该定理将楔形分解为半简单且可解的数据，记录这些组件如何耦合，并提供楔形的逆重构。该框架产生生成代数的四种结构类型。我们进一步证明，每个可允许生成元的总耗散强度仅取决于其在可解根式中的坐标。特别是，如果生成的李代数是半简单的，则每个可接受的生成器都是哈密顿量。总之，这些结果将李代数结构方法扩展到不可逆马尔可夫控制，并阐明了耗散如何在发电机几何中编码。

title: Quantum Chaos and Quantum Optimal Transport
abstract: Chaos in classical systems can be characterized by Lyapunov exponents that measure the exponential divergence of nearby trajectories, but directly extending this framework to quantum mechanics has been a persistent challenge. The wavelike nature of quantum states and the non-commutative geometry of quantum phase space obstruct a straightforward generalization of classical chaos theory. Here we develop a rigorous approach to quantum chaos by leveraging quantum optimal transport theory, which provides the missing geometric foundation for measuring distances between extended quantum distributions. We define quantum Lyapunov exponents that naturally avoid divergences encountered when naïvely generalizing classical exponents, and show that in the semiclassical limit they recover the classical global expansion rate, and hence the usual maximal Lyapunov exponent when they coincide. Our framework provides a tight connection between the divergence of classical trajectories and semiclassical phase space evolution, and additionally clarifies the role of out-of-time-order correlators as diagnostics of quantum chaos. These results establish quantum optimal transport as a unifying mathematical foundation for quantum chaos theory, providing new tools to characterize dynamical behavior across the full range of quantum dynamics from simple few-body models to complex many-body systems.
summary:
经典系统中的混沌可以用测量附近轨迹的指数散度的李雅普诺夫指数来表征，但直接将该框架扩展到量子力学一直是一个持续的挑战。量子态的波状性质和量子相空间的非交换几何阻碍了经典混沌理论的直接推广。在这里，我们利用量子最优传输理论开发了一种严格的量子混沌方法，该理论为测量扩展量子分布之间的距离提供了缺失的几何基础。我们定义了量子李亚普诺夫指数，它自然地避免了天真概括经典指数时遇到的发散，并表明在半经典极限下，它们恢复了经典全局膨胀率，因此当它们重合时恢复了通常的最大李亚普诺夫指数。我们的框架提供了经典轨迹的分歧和半经典相空间演化之间的紧密联系，并且还阐明了失序相关器作为量子混沌诊断的作用。

这些结果将量子最优输运确立为量子混沌理论的统一数学基础，提供了新的工具来表征从简单的少体模型到复杂的多体系统的整个量子动力学范围内的动力学行为。

title: On supporting affine functionals for Entanglement of Formation
abstract: In several articles, the authors assume that the convex roof structure of the EoF and finite-dimensionality of subsystems $A$ and $B$ guarantee the existence of the (global) supporting affine functional for the EoF at any state of the system $AB$. This means that for any state $\rho$ of $AB$ there is a Hermitian operator $\Lambda_\rho$ on $\mathcal{H}_{AB}=\mathcal{H}_A\otimes\mathcal{H}_B$ such that $E_F(\rho)=\mathrm{Tr}\Lambda_\rho\rho$ and $E_F(\sigma)\geq\mathrm{Tr}\Lambda_\rho\sigma$ for any state $\sigma$ of $AB$. We present an explicit example showing that, when $\rho$ is degenerate, this is not true even in the simplest case when $A$ and $B$ are qubit systems. The construction is based on the fact that the existence of a supporting affine functional for the EoF at a state $\rho$ is equivalent to the Lipschitz lower semicontinuity of the EoF at this state $\rho$. We use Wootters' formula and the help of Claude Fable 5 to find a state $\rho$ of the system $AB$ for which the latter property does not hold. We also describe conditions for the existence the local and global supporting affine functionals for the EoF at a given state of both finite and infinite-dimensional bipartite quantum systems. These conditions allow us to find Lipschitz lower semicontinuity bounds for the EoF at a given finite rank state $\rho$ (i.e. inequalities of the form $\,E_F(\rho)-E_F(\sigma)\leq C_\rho\|\rho-\sigma\|_1$) with and without restrictions on the support of the state $\sigma$.
summary:
在几篇文章中，作者假设 EoF 的凸屋顶结构以及子系统 $A$ 和 $B$ 的有限维性保证了在系统 $AB$ 的任何状态下 EoF 的（全局）支持仿射函数的存在。这意味着对于 $AB$ 的任何状态 $\rho$ ，在 $\mathcal{H}_{AB}=\mathcal{H}_A\otimes\mathcal{H}_B$ 上都存在厄米算子 $\Lambda_\rho$，使得 $E_F(\rho)=\mathrm{Tr}\Lambda_\rho\rho$ 和$E_F(\sigma)\geq\mathrm{Tr}\Lambda_\rho\sigma$ 对于 $AB$ 的任何状态 $\sigma$。我们提出了一个明确的例子，表明当 $\rho$ 退化时，即使在 $A$ 和 $B$ 是量子位系统的最简单情况下，情况也不是如此。该构造基于以下事实：在 $\rho$ 状态下 EoF 的支持仿射泛函的存在等效于在该状态 $\rho$ 下 EoF 的 Lipschitz 下半连续性。我们使用伍特斯公式并在克劳德寓言 5 的帮助下找到系统 $AB$ 的状态 $\rho$，而后一个属性不成立。

我们还描述了有限维和无限维二部量子系统给定状态下 EoF 的局部和全局支持仿射泛函的存在条件。这些条件使我们能够在给定的有限秩状态 $\rho$ 下找到 EoF 的 Lipschitz 下半连续界（即 $\,E_F(\rho)-E_F(\sigma)\leq C_\rho\|\rho-\sigma\|_1$ 形式的不等式），无论状态 $\sigma$ 的支持是否受到限制。

title: Krylov Break Times from an Inhomogeneous Lieb--Robinson Light Cone
abstract: Krylov and Lanczos approximations are used in quantum dynamics, quantum subspace methods, and Hamiltonian learning. A practical question is how long an $m$-dimensional Krylov truncation can be trusted. We argue that this time is fixed by causal propagation on the associated Jacobi chain. The relevant distance is not the Krylov index itself, but the inhomogeneous transport metric $\rho(m,n) = \sum_{j=\min(m,n)}^{\max(m,n)-1} 1/b_j$, where $b_j$ is the Lanczos hopping across the bond $j \leftrightarrow j+1$. We prove a Lieb--Robinson bound in this metric. Its small-weight limit gives the velocity $v_{\rm LR} = 2$, meaning that propagation is exponentially suppressed outside the cone $\rho(m,n) \simeq 2|t|$. The error of a finite Krylov approximation to the return amplitude is a round-trip effect: information has to travel from the probe to the truncation boundary and back. Combining the Lieb--Robinson bound with Duhamel's formula yields a lower bound on the error of the truncated dynamics. For a fixed tolerance $\epsilon$, let the break time $t_\ast(m;\epsilon)$ denote the longest time for which the $m$-dimensional truncation is guaranteed to reproduce the exact return amplitude within error $\epsilon$. We show that $t_\ast(m;\epsilon) \ge \tau_m[1-o(1)]$, where $\tau_m = \rho(0,m) = \sum_{j<m} 1/b_j$. When the probe spreads along the chain, this lower bound is also tight, so $t_\ast(m) \simeq \tau_m$. The situation is different when the probe excites only a localized part of the spectrum, or a part already resolved by the truncation. In this case, essentially no signal reaches the boundary. Beyond a state-dependent Krylov dimension $m_\ast$, the approximation can therefore remain accurate at all times, and the break time is effectively infinite. Numerical tests on spin chains and random Jacobi matrices support $t_\ast(m) \simeq \tau_m$ in the transport-limited regime.
summary:
Krylov 和 Lanczos 近似用于量子动力学、量子子空间方法和哈密顿学习。一个实际问题是 $m$ 维 Krylov 截断的可信度有多长。我们认为这个时间是通过相关雅可比链上的因果传播来确定的。相关距离不是 Krylov 指数本身，而是非齐次传输度量 $\rho(m,n) = \sum_{j=\min(m,n)}^{\max(m,n)-1} 1/b_j$，其中 $b_j$ 是跨越键 $j \leftrightarrow j+1$ 的 Lanczos 跳跃。我们证明了该度量的 Lieb-Robinson 界。它的小重量限制给出了速度 $v_{\rm LR} = 2$，这意味着在锥体 $\rho(m,n) \simeq 2|t|$ 之外传播受到指数抑制。有限克雷洛夫近似对返回幅度的误差是一种往返效应：信息必须从探头传播到截断边界并返回。将 Lieb-Robinson 界与 Duhamel 公式相结合，得出截断动力学误差的下界。

对于固定容差 $\epsilon$，令中断时间 $t_\ast(m;\epsilon)$ 表示保证 $m$ 维截断在误差 $\epsilon$ 内再现精确返回幅度的最长时间。我们证明 $t_\ast(m;\epsilon) \ge \tau_m[1-o(1)]$，其中 $\tau_m = \rho(0,m) = \sum_{j<m} 1/b_j$。当探针沿着链传播时，这个下界也很紧，因此 $t_\ast(m) \simeq \tau_m$。当探头仅激发光谱的局部部分或已通过截断解析的部分时，情况会有所不同。在这种情况下，基本上没有信号到达边界。因此，除了依赖于状态的 Krylov 维 $m_\ast$ 之外，近似值可以始终保持准确，并且中断时间实际上是无限的。自旋链和随机雅可比矩阵的数值测试支持传输限制条件下的 $t_\ast(m) \simeq \tau_m$。

title: Factorized Boolean representations for efficient quantum synthesis
abstract: Quantum algorithms promise advantages beyond classical reach, but running them on error-corrected hardware requires translating Boolean specifications into reversible circuits, and the resources that translation demands determine what is executable. Established methods minimize a Boolean expression and map it to a circuit, assuming the minimized form is best. Here we show that minimized expressions retain algebraic structure minimization cannot reach, arising from containment and complementary-polarity relationships among their terms, and that extracting it yields circuits cheaper to execute despite having more operations. The decisive quantity is not a circuit's operation count but the control count of its widest operation, a superlinear cost; extracting shared factors trades a few wide operations for many narrow ones and reduces qubit count. Across benchmarks and oracles from quantum search and factoring algorithms, at the representation level the transformation never increases either cost measure, a guarantee from its construction. Translation to an executable circuit returns part of that advantage, since auxiliary lines must be uncomputed, yet the factorized circuit still left a leading circuit-level optimizer reaching lower final counts, and faster, than unaided. The representation of a computation is therefore itself a resource, optimizable before compilation and distinct from both logic minimization and circuit-level optimization.
summary:
量子算法有望带来超越经典的优势，但在纠错硬件上运行它们需要将布尔规范转换为可逆电路，而转换所需的资源决定了可执行的内容。已建立的方法最小化布尔表达式并将其映射到电路，假设最小化形式是最好的。在这里，我们表明，最小化表达式保留了最小化无法达到的代数结构，这是由于它们的项之间的包含和互补极性关系而产生的，并且提取它会产生尽管有更多操作但执行起来更便宜的电路。决定性的量不是电路的运算次数，而是其最宽运算的控制次数，即超线性成本；提取共享因子将一些广泛的操作替换为许多狭窄的操作，并减少了量子比特数。跨越量子搜索和分解算法的基准和预言，在表示层面上，转换永远不会增加任何成本衡量标准，这是其构建的保证。

转换为可执行电路返回了该优势的一部分，因为辅助线必须不被计算，但因式分解电路仍然留下领先的电路级优化器，与无辅助相比，达到更低的最终计数并且更快。因此，计算的表示本身就是一种资源，可以在编译之前进行优化，并且与逻辑最小化和电路级优化不同。

title: Dynamics of local quantum information in random unitary circuits
abstract: The physics of information scrambling in quantum many-body systems is intimately related to thermalisation and emergence of chaos. However, its standard characterisation through bipartite entanglement or operator growth remains inherently coarse-grained, obscuring the spatiotemporal anatomy of how quantum information flows between different regions of the system and across various length scales. In this work, we develop a theory for the dynamics of local information in local random unitary circuits which resolves the fine-grained microscopic structures of local information flow in such systems. Using the framework of information lattice which systematises the information content at each length scale within each subsystem, we identify a distribution of length scales at which information resides and obtain the dynamics of the distribution. For Haar-random circuits with infinite local Hilbert-space dimensions, we map this dynamics onto an exact classical stochastic process which reveals that this distribution is described by a Tracy-Widom form which moves ballistically in time ($ \propto t$) toward larger scales, accompanied by a $\sim t^{1/3}$ broadening. We also find the same qualitative behaviour for random Clifford circuits acting on qubits. The similar scaling behaviour in two rather different settings hints strongly towards the universality of our results. In the case of Clifford circuits, we develop a phenomenological Markov process for the dynamics of the stabiliser generators in a specific gauge which confirms the Tracy-Widom distribution and the $t^{1/3}$ scaling of the fluctuations. Ultimately, our results establish the universal properties of the dynamics of local quantum information in a length scale-resolved fashion and provide a possible route towards bridging exact microscopic theories for information dynamics with emergent hydrodynamic descriptions of information flow.
summary:
量子多体系统中的信息扰乱物理学与热化和混沌的出现密切相关。然而，它通过二分纠缠或算子增长的标准表征本质上仍然是粗粒度的，模糊了量子信息如何在系统的不同区域和不同长度尺度之间流动的时空解剖结构。在这项工作中，我们发展了一种局部随机酉电路中局部信息动力学的理论，该理论解决了此类系统中局部信息流的细粒度微观结构。利用信息格的框架，系统化了每个子系统内每个长度尺度的信息内容，我们识别了信息所在的长度尺度的分布，并获得了分布的动态。对于具有无限局部希尔伯特空间维度的 Haar 随机电路，我们将这种动力学映射到精确的经典随机过程，该过程揭示了这种分布是由 Tracy-Widom 形式描述的，该形式随时间 ($ \propto t$) 向更大尺度弹道移动，并伴随着 $\sim t^{1/3}$ 展宽。

我们还发现作用于量子位的随机 Clifford 电路具有相同的定性行为。在两种截然不同的设置中相似的缩放行为强烈暗示了我们结果的普遍性。就 Clifford 电路而言，我们针对特定规范中稳定器发生器的动态开发了唯象马尔可夫过程，该过程确认了 Tracy-Widom 分布和波动的 $t^{1/3}$ 缩放。最终，我们的结果以长度尺度解析的方式建立了局域量子信息动力学的普遍性质，并为将信息动力学的精确微观理论与信息流的新兴流体动力学描述联系起来提供了一条可能的途径。

title: Spectral Fingerprints of Gauge Theories on a Quantum Computer
abstract: Maximally mixed state spectral sampling is an unbiased quantum algorithm that allows for extraction of a finite-resolution spectral distribution from a Hamiltonian over potentially the entire allowed range of energies. We show how it may be focused on any desired area of the spectrum in order to learn about the full \textit{fingerprint} of the model of interest: from its ground state phenomena such as quantum criticality, obtained from the lowest lying energies, to its thermalization behavior, obtained from the mid-spectrum. We demonstrate this technique specifically on a $(1+1)d$ non-Abelian $SO(3)$ gauge theory, providing a comprehensive analysis of the steps necessary for performing this algorithm, as well as what is possible in the near-term with superconducting quantum hardware, performing simulations with circuits that are $78$ two-qubit gates deep. We show how this algorithm is able to take advantage of emerging dynamical circuit capabilities in near-term hardware to roughly halve the number required qubits, as well as how quantum readout error mitigation is trivial for this method. Along the way, we propose a novel strategy for compiling the controlled-time evolutions needed for spectral sampling by means of Pauli-frame optimizations. We illustrate two physical applications of quantum spectral sampling -- disordered many-body transitions, and mid-spectrum densities of states -- and what postprocessing steps they require beyond the Fourier outputs of the algorithm.
summary:
最大混合态光谱采样是一种无偏量子算法，允许在整个允许的能量范围内从哈密顿量中提取有限分辨率光谱分布。我们展示了它如何聚焦于光谱的任何所需区域，以便了解感兴趣模型的完整\textit{指纹}：从其基态现象（例如从最低能量获得的量子临界性）到从中间光谱获得的热化行为。我们专门在 $(1+1)d$ 非阿贝尔 $SO(3)$ 规范理论上演示了这项技术，对执行该算法所需的步骤进行了全面分析，以及近期使用超导量子硬件的可能性，用 78$ 两个量子位门深的电路进行模拟。我们展示了该算法如何利用近期硬件中新兴的动态电路功能将所需的量子位数量大致减半，以及如何减轻量子读出错误对于该方法来说是微不足道的。

在此过程中，我们提出了一种新颖的策略，通过泡利框架优化来编译光谱采样所需的受控时间演化。我们说明了量子光谱采样的两个物理应用——无序多体跃迁和中光谱状态密度——以及除了算法的傅立叶输出之外它们还需要哪些后处理步骤。
